```{r}
#| label: season enhancement setup
#| output: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# ===============================================================
# Season versions of the match-dashboard sections (set pieces, shot
# sequences, entries, transitions, defensive shape, standard PPDA,
# goalkeepers, match-by-match trends). Same definitions as the match
# dashboard; the focus team is Match_Home and every opponent is grouped
# as Match_Away ("All Oppo"). Sequences never run across two games.
# Definitions are on the Methodology page.
# ===============================================================
library(zoo)
library(scales)

# ---- shared helpers (same as the match dashboard) -----------------
num0 <- function(df, col) {
  if (col %in% names(df)) coalesce(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[col]])), 0) else rep(0, nrow(df))
}
numNA <- function(df, col) {
  if (col %in% names(df)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[col]])) else rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
}
has_qual <- function(df, code) {
  qc <- grep("^qualifiers/\\d+/type/value$", names(df), value = TRUE)
  if (length(qc) == 0) return(rep(FALSE, nrow(df)))
  Reduce(`|`, lapply(qc, function(cl) coalesce(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[cl]])) == code, FALSE)))
}
surname_particles <- c("mac", "mc", "van", "von", "der", "den", "de", "di", "da", "do",
                       "dos", "das", "del", "della", "le", "la", "ter", "ten", "el", "al",
                       "bin", "ben", "st.", "saint")
short_name <- function(x) {
  vapply(as.character(x), function(n) {
    if (is.na(n)) return(NA_character_)
    w <- strsplit(trimws(n), "\\s+")[[1]]
    if (length(w) <= 1) return(n)
    i <- length(w)
    while (i > 2 && tolower(w[i - 1]) %in% surname_particles) i <- i - 1
    paste(w[i:length(w)], collapse = " ")
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
ball_icon <- file.path(data_root, "Icons/ball2.png")

opp_of     <- function(team) ifelse(team == Match_Home, Match_Away, Match_Home)
team_col   <- function(team) ifelse(team == Match_Home, Color_Home, Color_Away)
team_txt   <- function(team) ifelse(team == Match_Home, Color_Home_Text, Color_Away_Text)
team_cols  <- setNames(c(Color_Home, Color_Away), c(Match_Home, Match_Away))
team_scale <- function(team) c("#FFFAFA", team_col(team))
col_success <- Color_Home      # successful / better
col_fail    <- "#9E9E9E"      # unsuccessful / worse
team_strip <- function(team) {
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8, colour = team_txt(team)),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = team_col(team), color = "black", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1))
}
pct_txt <- function(a, b) ifelse(b > 0, paste0(round(100 * a / b), "%"), "-")
f2 <- function(v) format(round(v, 2), nsmall = 2)
channel_levels <- c("Left wing", "Left half-space", "Central", "Right half-space", "Right wing")
channel_of <- function(y) {
  factor(case_when(y >= 78.9 ~ "Left wing", y >= 63.2 ~ "Left half-space", y >= 36.8 ~ "Central",
                   y >= 21.1 ~ "Right half-space", TRUE ~ "Right wing"), levels = channel_levels)
}
third_of <- function(x) case_when(x >= 66.7 ~ "Att third", x >= 33.3 ~ "Mid third", TRUE ~ "Def third")
in_box   <- function(x, y) coalesce(x >= 83 & y >= 21.1 & y <= 78.9, FALSE)
quarter_levels <- c("1st Quarter", "2nd Quarter", "3rd Quarter", "4th Quarter", "Injury Time")

# season subtitle used on the new plots and tables
last_game_date <- max(game_dates$.date, na.rm = TRUE)
Season_Label <- paste0(Match_Home, " | ", Competition, " | ", n_games, " games to ", format(last_game_date, "%d-%m-%Y"))

gt_caption <- "X @Barts78 | Bluesky @barts78 | Mastodon @DrBarts | GitHub Barts78 | LinkedIn Phil-barter | Data: Opta"

theme_ai <- function(title_size = 8, subtitle_size = 6, axis = FALSE, axis_size = 6,
                     legend_position = "none") {
  t <- theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
             plot.caption = element_markdown(),
             panel.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
             plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold", size = title_size),
             plot.title.position = "plot",
             plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "black", size = subtitle_size),
             legend.position = legend_position)
  if (axis) {
    t <- t + theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = axis_size),
                   axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = axis_size, face = "bold"))
  }
  t
}
pitch_base <- function(fill = "#DBDBDB", line_col = "#454545", zone_lwd = 0.3,
                       zone_col = "#95A5A6", labels = FALSE, label_size = 2) {
  list(
    annotate_pitch(dimensions = pitch_opta, fill = fill, colour = line_col),
    theme_pitch(),
    annotate("segment", y = c(21.1, 36.8, 63.2, 78.9), yend = c(21.1, 36.8, 63.2, 78.9),
             x = 0, xend = 100, linetype = "longdash", linewidth = zone_lwd, colour = zone_col),
    annotate("segment", x = c(17, 33.2, 50, 66.4, 83), xend = c(17, 33.2, 50, 66.4, 83),
             y = 0, yend = 100, linetype = "longdash", linewidth = zone_lwd, colour = zone_col),
    if (labels) geom_text(data = data.frame(x = 74.7, y = c(50, 71.05, 28.95), label = c("14", "LHS", "RHS")),
                          aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = label_size, colour = "grey")
  )
}
pitch_title <- function(title, subtitle = Season_Label) {
  list(labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, caption = My_caption),
       theme_ai(title_size = 9, subtitle_size = 6, legend_position = "bottom"),
       theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.title = element_blank(),
             legend.background = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA),
             legend.key = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA)))
}
line_theme <- function(legend_position = "top") {
  list(theme_ai(title_size = 10, subtitle_size = 7, axis = TRUE, axis_size = 7, legend_position = legend_position),
       theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey88", linewidth = 0.3),
             legend.background = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA),
             legend.key = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA),
             legend.text = element_text(size = 7)))
}

ai_gt <- function(df, title, subtitle = Season_Label, group = NULL, rowname = NULL) {
  gt(df, groupname_col = group, rowname_col = rowname) %>%
    tab_header(title = md(paste0("**", title, "**")), subtitle = subtitle) %>%
    tab_source_note(gt_caption) %>%
    cols_align(align = "right", columns = everything()) %>%
    sub_missing(missing_text = "-") %>%
    tab_options(heading.padding = px(1), heading.align = "left",
                column_labels.background.color = "#DBDBDB",
                row_group.background.color = "ivory4",
                stub.background.color = "#DBDBDB",
                column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black",
                table.font.size = 13, heading.title.font.size = 16,
                heading.subtitle.font.size = 13, source_notes.font.size = 8,
                table.width = "100%") %>%
    tab_style(locations = cells_title(groups = "title"),
              style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", size = 16)))
}
gt_team_groups <- function(tbl, groups) {
  for (tm in intersect(c(Match_Home, Match_Away), groups)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>% tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = team_txt(tm)),
                                          cell_fill(color = team_col(tm))),
                             locations = cells_row_groups(groups = tm))
  }
  tbl
}
gt_team_spanners <- function(tbl) {
  for (tm in c(Match_Home, Match_Away)) {
    tbl <- tbl %>% tab_spanner(label = tm, id = tm, columns = starts_with(paste0(tm, " | "))) %>%
      tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = team_txt(tm)), cell_fill(color = team_col(tm))),
                locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = tm))
  }
  tbl %>% cols_label_with(columns = contains(" | "), fn = function(n) sub("^.* \\| ", "", n))
}
# colour the two team-value columns of a "Metric | Liverpool | All Oppo" table
gt_team_columns <- function(tbl, cols_home, cols_away) {
  tbl %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = Color_Home_Text), cell_fill(color = Color_Home)),
              locations = cells_column_labels(columns = all_of(cols_home))) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = Color_Away_Text), cell_fill(color = Color_Away)),
              locations = cells_column_labels(columns = all_of(cols_away)))
}

# ---- game list: one row per game -----------------------------------
games <- plottingData %>%
  group_by(game_name) %>%
  summarise(Match_day = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dplyr::first(Match_day))),
            Opponent  = dplyr::first(TeamName[Team_Group == Match_Away]),
            Venue     = ifelse(dplyr::first(Focus_Home), "H", "A"),
            GF = sum(Focus_Goal[period < 5]), GA = sum(Oppo_Goal[period < 5]),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(game_dates %>% select(game_name, Date = .date, Game_Block), by = "game_name") %>%
  arrange(Date, Match_day) %>%
  mutate(Game_No = row_number(),
         Opp_Abbr = toupper(substr(gsub("[^A-Za-z]", "", Opponent), 1, 3)),
         Result = case_when(GF > GA ~ "W", GF < GA ~ "L", TRUE ~ "D"),
         Game_Label = paste0(Game_No, ". ", Opp_Abbr, " (", Venue, ") ", GF, "-", GA))
game_levels <- games$Game_Label

# ---- event table: games in date order, events in match order ------
ev <- plottingData %>%
  mutate(.row = row_number()) %>%
  filter(period < 5) %>%
  left_join(games %>% select(game_name, Game_No), by = "game_name") %>%
  mutate(Opp_Name = TeamName, TeamName = Team_Group) %>%
  arrange(Game_No, period, .row)

ev <- ev %>%
  mutate(
    tv        = num0(ev, "type/value"),
    out       = num0(ev, "outcomeType/value"),
    sec       = coalesce(as.numeric(minute), 0) * 60 + num0(ev, "second"),
    OG        = num0(ev, "Own_Goals") == 1,
    is_pass   = tv %in% c(1, 2),
    is_shot   = num0(ev, "TotalShots") == 1 & !OG,
    on_target = num0(ev, "OTShots") == 1,
    is_cross  = num0(ev, "Cross_Passes") == 1,
    is_long   = num0(ev, "Long_Passes") == 1,
    da        = num0(ev, "Defensive_Action") == 1,
    ft_touch  = num0(ev, "Final_Third_Touches") == 1,
    touch     = num0(ev, "Touches") == 1,
    xg        = num0(ev, "xG"),
    npxg      = num0(ev, "NPxG"),
    xgot      = num0(ev, "xGOT"),
    epv       = num0(ev, "EPVvalue"),
    x         = numNA(ev, "x"),
    y         = numNA(ev, "y"),
    end_x     = numNA(ev, "finalX"),
    end_y     = numNA(ev, "finalY"),
    dist_m    = sqrt(((end_x - x) * 1.05)^2 + ((end_y - y) * 0.68)^2),
    short_flag = num0(ev, "Short_Corners") == 1,
    corner    = is_pass & (num0(ev, "Corners") == 1 | short_flag | has_qual(ev, 6)),
    free_kick = is_pass & !corner & (num0(ev, "FreeKicks") == 1 | has_qual(ev, 5)),
    throw_in  = is_pass & has_qual(ev, 107),
    goal_kick = is_pass & has_qual(ev, 124),
    kick_off  = is_pass & has_qual(ev, 279),
    dead_ball = corner | free_kick | throw_in | goal_kick | kick_off,
    pen       = is_shot & has_qual(ev, 9),
    blocked   = is_shot & has_qual(ev, 82),
    sit       = if ("situation" %in% names(ev)) as.character(situation) else NA_character_,
    on_ball   = is_pass | is_shot | tv %in% c(3, 8, 49, 52, 54, 61) | (tv %in% c(7, 11) & out == 1),
    ppda_da   = tv %in% c(7, 8, 45) | (tv == 4 & out == 0)
  )

# ---- sequences: new one when the team on the ball, the period or the
#      game changes, or play restarts from a dead ball ----------------
seq_ids <- ev %>%
  filter(on_ball) %>%
  mutate(new_seq = row_number() == 1 |
                   coalesce(TeamName != dplyr::lag(TeamName), TRUE) |
                   coalesce(period != dplyr::lag(period), TRUE) |
                   coalesce(game_name != dplyr::lag(game_name), TRUE) | dead_ball,
         seq_id = cumsum(new_seq)) %>%
  select(.row, seq_id)

ev <- ev %>%
  left_join(seq_ids, by = ".row") %>%
  group_by(game_name) %>% tidyr::fill(seq_id, .direction = "down") %>% ungroup() %>%
  group_by(seq_id) %>%
  mutate(cum_passes = cumsum(is_pass & on_ball)) %>%
  ungroup()

seqs <- ev %>%
  filter(on_ball, !is.na(seq_id)) %>%
  group_by(seq_id) %>%
  summarise(TeamName = dplyr::first(TeamName), game_name = dplyr::first(game_name), period = dplyr::first(period),
            start_sec = dplyr::first(sec), start_x = dplyr::first(x), start_y = dplyr::first(y),
            starter = dplyr::first(playerId), start_tv = dplyr::first(tv),
            s_corner = dplyr::first(corner), s_fk = dplyr::first(free_kick), s_throw = dplyr::first(throw_in),
            s_gk = dplyr::first(goal_kick), s_ko = dplyr::first(kick_off), n_events = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(start_type = case_when(s_corner ~ "Corner", s_fk ~ "Free kick", s_throw ~ "Throw-in",
                                s_gk ~ "Goal kick", s_ko ~ "Kick-off",
                                start_tv %in% c(10, 11, 52, 54) ~ "Keeper",
                                TRUE ~ "Open-play regain"),
         start_zone = paste0(third_of(start_x), ", ", channel_of(start_y)))

# ---- shots joined back to their sequence ---------------------------
shot_class <- function(sit, start_type, pen) {
  s <- tolower(coalesce(sit, ""))
  case_when(pen | grepl("pen", s) ~ "Penalty",
            grepl("corner|set ?piece|free ?kick|throw", s) ~ "Set piece",
            s %in% c("", "na") & start_type %in% c("Corner", "Free kick", "Throw-in") ~ "Set piece",
            TRUE ~ "Open play")
}
shot_seq <- ev %>%
  filter(is_shot) %>%
  select(.row, seq_id, TeamName, game_name, Game_No, playerId, expandedMinute, minute, period, sec,
         shot_x = x, shot_y = y, xg, xgot, tv, pen, blocked, on_target, sit, cum_passes) %>%
  left_join(seqs %>% select(seq_id, start_sec, start_x, start_y, starter, start_type, start_zone), by = "seq_id") %>%
  left_join(games %>% select(game_name, Opp_Abbr), by = "game_name") %>%
  mutate(Shooter  = short_name(playerId),
         Duration = pmax(0, round(sec - start_sec)),
         Passes   = cum_passes,
         Goal     = tv == 16,
         Result   = case_when(tv == 16 ~ "Goal", blocked ~ "Blocked", tv == 15 ~ "Saved",
                              tv == 14 ~ "Post", TRUE ~ "Off target"),
         Class    = shot_class(sit, start_type, pen))

# ---- set pieces ----------------------------------------------------
contact_cand <- ev$on_ball | ev$tv %in% c(4, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 41, 44, 45, 74)
first_contact_at <- function(i) {
  if (i >= nrow(ev)) return(NA_character_)
  j <- (i + 1):min(i + 6, nrow(ev))
  j <- j[coalesce(ev$game_name[j] == ev$game_name[i] & ev$period[j] == ev$period[i] &
                    (ev$sec[j] - ev$sec[i]) <= 8, FALSE)]
  stop_at <- which(ev$tv[j] %in% c(5, 6) | ev$dead_ball[j])
  if (length(stop_at)) j <- j[seq_len(stop_at[1] - 1)]
  j <- j[contact_cand[j]]
  if (length(j) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  if (ev$tv[j[1]] == 44) {
    a <- j[ev$tv[j] == 44 & ev$out[j] == 1]
    if (length(a)) return(as.character(ev$TeamName[a[1]]))
  }
  as.character(ev$TeamName[j[1]])
}
sp_idx <- which(ev$corner | ev$free_kick | ev$throw_in)
sp_events <- ev[sp_idx, ] %>%
  mutate(sp_type  = case_when(corner ~ "Corner", free_kick ~ "Free kick", TRUE ~ "Throw-in"),
         short    = corner & (short_flag | coalesce(dist_m < 20, FALSE)),
         delivery = case_when(sp_type == "Corner" & short ~ "Short corner",
                              sp_type == "Corner" ~ "Direct corner",
                              in_box(end_x, end_y) ~ "Into box",
                              coalesce(end_x >= 66.7, FALSE) ~ "Into final third",
                              TRUE ~ "Other"),
         contact_team  = vapply(sp_idx, first_contact_at, character(1)),
         First_Contact = case_when(is.na(contact_team) ~ "No contact",
                                   contact_team == TeamName ~ "Won", TRUE ~ "Lost"),
         Taker = short_name(playerId))

# season set-piece summary: totals and per game
sp_summary_team <- function(team) {
  s  <- sp_events %>% filter(TeamName == team)
  co <- s %>% filter(sp_type == "Corner"); dc <- co %>% filter(delivery == "Direct corner")
  fk <- s %>% filter(sp_type == "Free kick"); ti <- s %>% filter(sp_type == "Throw-in")
  sh <- shot_seq %>% filter(TeamName == team)
  op <- sh %>% filter(Class == "Open play"); sp <- sh %>% filter(Class == "Set piece"); pk <- sh %>% filter(Class == "Penalty")
  tibble(
    Section = c(rep("Corners", 4), rep("Free kicks", 3), rep("Throw-ins", 2), rep("Shots by situation", 9)),
    Metric = c("Corners taken", "Short", "Direct", "Direct - first contact won",
               "Free kicks (passes)", "Into final third / box", "Into box",
               "Throw-ins", "Retained (first touch)",
               "Open-play shots", "Open-play xG", "Open-play goals",
               "Set-piece shots", "Set-piece xG", "Set-piece goals",
               "Penalties", "Penalty xG", "Set-piece share of xG"),
    Total = c(nrow(co), sum(co$short), nrow(dc), sum(dc$First_Contact == "Won"),
              nrow(fk), sum(fk$delivery %in% c("Into box", "Into final third")), sum(fk$delivery == "Into box"),
              nrow(ti), sum(ti$First_Contact == "Won"),
              nrow(op), sum(op$xg), sum(op$Goal), nrow(sp), sum(sp$xg), sum(sp$Goal),
              nrow(pk), sum(pk$xg), NA),
    Rate = c(NA, NA, NA, pct_txt(sum(dc$First_Contact == "Won"), nrow(dc)), NA, NA, NA, NA,
             pct_txt(sum(ti$First_Contact == "Won"), nrow(ti)), NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,
             pct_txt(sum(sp$xg), sum(sh$xg)))
  ) %>%
    mutate(`Per game` = ifelse(is.na(Total), NA, round(Total / n_games, 2)),
           Total = ifelse(grepl("xG", Metric), round(Total, 2), Total))
}
sp_summary <- sp_summary_team(Match_Home) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(Match_Home, " | ", .x), c(Total, `Per game`, Rate)) %>%
  left_join(sp_summary_team(Match_Away) %>% rename_with(~ paste0(Match_Away, " | ", .x), c(Total, `Per game`, Rate)),
            by = c("Section", "Metric"))

# ---- carries and box / final-third entries --------------------------
pipeline_carries <- all(c("Carry_Start_X", "Carry_Start_Y", "C_End_point_X", "C_End_point_Y") %in% names(ev))
season_carries <- if (pipeline_carries) {
  ev %>%
    filter(num0(ev, "Attempted_Carries") == 1) %>%
    transmute(.row, TeamName, game_name, playerId, period,
              x = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Carry_Start_X)), y = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Carry_Start_Y)),
              end_x = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(C_End_point_X)), end_y = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(C_End_point_Y)),
              Kind = "Carry", Success = coalesce(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Successful_Carries)), 0) == 1)
} else {
  ev %>%
    filter(on_ball) %>%
    mutate(prev_ok = dplyr::lag(is_pass & out == 1),
           c_x = ifelse(coalesce(prev_ok, FALSE), dplyr::lag(end_x), dplyr::lag(x)),
           c_y = ifelse(coalesce(prev_ok, FALSE), dplyr::lag(end_y), dplyr::lag(y)),
           same_seq = coalesce(seq_id == dplyr::lag(seq_id), FALSE) & !dead_ball,
           c_dist = sqrt(((x - c_x) * 1.05)^2 + ((y - c_y) * 0.68)^2)) %>%
    filter(same_seq, coalesce(c_dist >= 5, FALSE)) %>%
    transmute(.row, TeamName, game_name, playerId, period, x = c_x, y = c_y, end_x = x, end_y = y,
              Kind = "Carry", Success = TRUE)
}
entries <- bind_rows(
  ev %>% filter(is_pass, !dead_ball) %>%
    transmute(.row, TeamName, game_name, playerId, period, x, y, end_x, end_y, Kind = "Pass", Success = out == 1),
  season_carries
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(end_x)) %>%
  mutate(box_entry = !in_box(x, y) & in_box(end_x, end_y),
         ft_entry  = x < 66.7 & end_x >= 66.7,
         Channel   = channel_of(y)) %>%
  filter(box_entry | ft_entry)

# per game averages by channel
entry_table <- bind_rows(
  entries %>% filter(box_entry) %>% mutate(Type = "Box"),
  entries %>% filter(ft_entry) %>% mutate(Type = "Final third")
) %>%
  mutate(TeamName = factor(TeamName, levels = c(Match_Home, Match_Away))) %>%
  group_by(TeamName, Type, Channel, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  summarise(Passes = sum(Kind == "Pass"), Carries = sum(Kind == "Carry"), Total = n(),
            Succ = sum(Success), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(TeamName = as.character(TeamName), Channel = as.character(Channel))
entry_table <- bind_rows(
  entry_table,
  entry_table %>% group_by(TeamName, Type) %>%
    summarise(across(c(Passes, Carries, Total, Succ), sum), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(Channel = "Total")
) %>%
  mutate(`Success %` = ifelse(Total > 0, round(100 * Succ / Total), NA),
         across(c(Passes, Carries, Total), ~ round(.x / n_games, 1))) %>%
  select(-Succ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Type)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = c(Passes, Carries, Total, `Success %`),
              names_glue = "{Type} | {.value}", values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Channel = factor(Channel, levels = c(channel_levels, "Total"))) %>%
  arrange(factor(TeamName, levels = c(Match_Home, Match_Away)), Channel) %>%
  mutate(Channel = as.character(Channel)) %>%
  select(TeamName, Channel, starts_with("Box | "), starts_with("Final third | "))

# ---- transitions --------------------------------------------------
regain_seqs  <- seqs %>% filter(start_type == "Open-play regain")
regain_shots <- shot_seq %>% filter(start_type == "Open-play regain")
fast_window <- 15   # seconds

transition_team <- function(team) {
  rs <- regain_seqs %>% filter(TeamName == team)
  sh <- regain_shots %>% filter(TeamName == team)
  fs <- sh %>% filter(Duration <= fast_window)
  oc <- regain_shots %>% filter(TeamName == opp_of(team), Duration <= fast_window)
  first_shot <- sh %>% group_by(seq_id) %>% summarise(t = min(Duration), .groups = "drop")
  tibble(
    Metric = c("Open-play regains", "Regains in attacking third", "Regains leading to a shot",
               paste0("Shots within ", fast_window, "s of regain"), paste0("xG within ", fast_window, "s"),
               paste0("Goals within ", fast_window, "s"), "Median time regain to shot (s)",
               paste0("Shots conceded within ", fast_window, "s of losing ball"),
               paste0("xG conceded within ", fast_window, "s"), paste0("Goals conceded within ", fast_window, "s")),
    Total = c(nrow(rs), sum(rs$start_x >= 66.7, na.rm = TRUE), n_distinct(sh$seq_id),
              nrow(fs), round(sum(fs$xg), 2), sum(fs$Goal),
              if (nrow(first_shot)) round(median(first_shot$t)) else NA,
              nrow(oc), round(sum(oc$xg), 2), sum(oc$Goal))
  ) %>%
    mutate(`Per game` = ifelse(grepl("Median", Metric), NA, round(Total / n_games, 2)))
}

# ---- defensive shape by quarter (season) ---------------------------
shape_data <- ev %>%
  filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(Game_Quarter)) %>%
  mutate(Game_Quarter = factor(Game_Quarter, levels = quarter_levels)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Game_Quarter))

block_method <- "mad"
mad_k <- 1.5
block_bounds <- function(v, lo_q = 0.1, hi_q = 0.9) {
  if (block_method == "mad") {
    m <- median(v); s <- median(abs(v - m)) / 0.6745
    c(lo = max(0, m - mad_k * s), hi = min(100, m + mad_k * s), mid = m)
  } else {
    c(lo = unname(quantile(v, lo_q)), hi = unname(quantile(v, hi_q)), mid = mean(v))
  }
}
shape_summary <- function(d, by) {
  d %>%
    filter(da) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(by))) %>%
    summarise(`Def. actions per game` = round(n() / n_distinct(game_name), 1),
              `DA height (m)` = round(mean(x) * 1.05, 1),
              x10 = block_bounds(x)[["lo"]], x90 = block_bounds(x)[["hi"]],
              y10 = block_bounds(y)[["lo"]], y90 = block_bounds(y)[["hi"]],
              xm = block_bounds(x)[["mid"]], .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(`Block depth (m)` = round((x90 - x10) * 1.05, 1),
           `Block width (m)` = round((y90 - y10) * 0.68, 1),
           `Block line (m)` = round(xm * 1.05, 1)) %>%
    left_join(d %>% filter(on_ball) %>% group_by(across(all_of(by))) %>%
                summarise(`On-ball height (m)` = round(mean(x) * 1.05, 1), .groups = "drop"), by = by)
}
def_shape <- shape_summary(shape_data, c("TeamName", "Game_Quarter")) %>%
  left_join(shape_data %>% filter(ft_touch) %>% count(Game_Quarter, TeamName) %>%
              group_by(Game_Quarter) %>% mutate(`Field tilt %` = round(100 * n / sum(n))) %>%
              ungroup() %>% select(-n),
            by = c("TeamName", "Game_Quarter"))
def_shape_game <- shape_summary(shape_data, c("TeamName", "game_name")) %>%
  left_join(games %>% select(game_name, Game_No, Game_Label), by = "game_name")

# ---- standard PPDA: season, halves, quarters and per game ---------
ppda_calc <- function(d, team) {
  passes <- sum(d$is_pass & d$TeamName == opp_of(team) & coalesce(d$x <= 60, FALSE))
  das    <- sum(d$ppda_da & d$TeamName == team & coalesce(d$x >= 40, FALSE))
  c(passes = passes, das = das, ppda = if (das > 0) round(passes / das, 2) else NA_real_)
}
ppda_periods <- list(
  `Season` = ev,
  `1st Half` = ev %>% filter(period == 1),
  `2nd Half` = ev %>% filter(period == 2),
  `1st Quarter` = ev %>% filter(Game_Quarter == "1st Quarter"),
  `2nd Quarter` = ev %>% filter(Game_Quarter == "2nd Quarter"),
  `3rd Quarter` = ev %>% filter(Game_Quarter == "3rd Quarter"),
  `4th Quarter` = ev %>% filter(Game_Quarter == "4th Quarter")
)
ppda_row <- function(label, d) {
  h <- ppda_calc(d, Match_Home); a <- ppda_calc(d, Match_Away)
  tibble(Period = label,
         !!paste0(Match_Home, " | Opp. passes") := h[["passes"]],
         !!paste0(Match_Home, " | Def. actions") := h[["das"]],
         !!paste0(Match_Home, " | PPDA") := h[["ppda"]],
         !!paste0(Match_Away, " | Opp. passes") := a[["passes"]],
         !!paste0(Match_Away, " | Def. actions") := a[["das"]],
         !!paste0(Match_Away, " | PPDA") := a[["ppda"]])
}
ppda_proper <- bind_rows(lapply(names(ppda_periods), function(p) ppda_row(p, ppda_periods[[p]])))

# ---- match-by-match trends ----------------------------------------
game_stats <- bind_rows(lapply(split(ev, ev$game_name), function(d) {
  bind_rows(lapply(c(Match_Home, Match_Away), function(tm) {
    tibble(game_name = d$game_name[1], TeamName = tm,
           xG = sum(d$xg[d$is_shot & d$TeamName == tm]),
           NPxG = sum(d$npxg[d$is_shot & d$TeamName == tm]),
           xGOT = sum(d$xgot[d$is_shot & d$TeamName == tm]),
           Shots = sum(d$is_shot & d$TeamName == tm),
           EPV = sum(d$epv[d$out == 1 & d$TeamName == tm]),
           Touches = sum(d$touch & d$TeamName == tm),
           FT_Touches = sum(d$ft_touch & d$TeamName == tm),
           PPDA = ppda_calc(d, tm)[["ppda"]])
  }))
})) %>%
  group_by(game_name) %>%
  mutate(`Possession %` = round(100 * Touches / sum(Touches), 1),
         `Field tilt %` = round(100 * FT_Touches / sum(FT_Touches), 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(games %>% select(game_name, Game_No, Game_Label, Match_day, Opponent, Venue, GF, GA, Result, Game_Block),
            by = "game_name") %>%
  mutate(Goals = ifelse(TeamName == Match_Home, GF, GA),
         Game_Label = factor(Game_Label, levels = game_levels),
         TeamName = factor(TeamName, levels = c(Match_Home, Match_Away))) %>%
  arrange(TeamName, Game_No) %>%
  group_by(TeamName) %>%
  mutate(across(c(xG, EPV, PPDA, `Field tilt %`), ~ zoo::rollapplyr(.x, 3, mean, na.rm = TRUE, partial = TRUE),
                .names = "{.col}_roll3"),
         Cum_Goals = cumsum(Goals), Cum_xG = cumsum(xG)) %>%
  ungroup()

# wide per-game table
trend_table <- game_stats %>%
  select(Game_No, Game_Label, Match_day, Opponent, Venue, TeamName, Goals, xG, NPxG, xGOT, Shots, EPV, `Field tilt %`, `Possession %`, PPDA) %>%
  mutate(across(c(xG, NPxG, xGOT, EPV), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = TeamName, values_from = c(Goals, xG, NPxG, xGOT, Shots, EPV, `Field tilt %`, `Possession %`, PPDA),
              names_glue = "{TeamName} | {.value}") %>%
  arrange(Game_No) %>%
  select(Game_No, Match_day, Opponent, Venue, starts_with(paste0(Match_Home, " | ")), starts_with(paste0(Match_Away, " | "))) %>%
  select(-any_of(c(paste0(Match_Away, " | Field tilt %"), paste0(Match_Away, " | Possession %"))))

# ---- goalkeepers --------------------------------------------------
gk_role <- if ("role" %in% names(ev)) coalesce(ev$role %in% c("Keeper", "GK", "Goalkeeper"), FALSE) else rep(FALSE, nrow(ev))
gk_players <- unique(ev$playerId[(gk_role | ev$tv %in% c(11, 41, 52, 54, 59)) & !is.na(ev$playerId)])
gk_ev <- ev %>%
  filter(playerId %in% gk_players) %>%
  mutate(Action = case_when(tv == 10 ~ "Save", tv == 11 ~ "Claim", tv == 41 ~ "Punch",
                            tv == 52 ~ "Pick-up", tv == 54 ~ "Smother", tv == 59 ~ "Sweeper",
                            da | tv %in% c(12, 49) ~ "Other defensive", TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         Sweeper = tv == 59 | (Action %in% c("Other defensive", "Claim", "Punch") & coalesce(x > 17, FALSE)),
         Distance = ifelse(is_long | coalesce(dist_m >= 32, FALSE), "Long", "Short"))

gk_summary_team <- function(team) {
  g  <- gk_ev %>% filter(TeamName == team)
  sf <- shot_seq %>% filter(TeamName == opp_of(team))
  sot <- sf %>% filter(on_target | Goal)
  ga  <- sum(sf$Goal)
  ps  <- g %>% filter(is_pass)
  lg  <- ps %>% filter(Distance == "Long"); st <- ps %>% filter(Distance == "Short")
  tibble(
    Section = c(rep("Shot stopping", 7), rep("Area & sweeping", 3), rep("Distribution", 6)),
    Metric = c("Shots on target faced", "xGOT faced", "Goals conceded (excl. OG)",
               "Goals prevented (xGOT - GA)", "Goals prevented per game", "Saves", "Save %",
               "Claims", "Punches", "Sweeper actions",
               "Passes", "Pass success %", "Short passes", "Short success %", "Long passes", "Long success %"),
    Value = c(nrow(sot), f2(sum(sot$xgot)), ga, f2(sum(sot$xgot) - ga), f2((sum(sot$xgot) - ga) / n_games),
              sum(g$Action == "Save", na.rm = TRUE), pct_txt(sum(g$Action == "Save", na.rm = TRUE), nrow(sot)),
              sum(g$Action == "Claim" & g$out == 1, na.rm = TRUE), sum(g$Action == "Punch", na.rm = TRUE),
              sum(g$Sweeper, na.rm = TRUE),
              nrow(ps), pct_txt(sum(ps$out == 1), nrow(ps)),
              nrow(st), pct_txt(sum(st$out == 1), nrow(st)),
              nrow(lg), pct_txt(sum(lg$out == 1), nrow(lg))) %>% as.character()
  )
}
gk_summary <- gk_summary_team(Match_Home) %>% dplyr::rename(!!Match_Home := Value) %>%
  left_join(gk_summary_team(Match_Away) %>% dplyr::rename(!!Match_Away := Value), by = c("Section", "Metric"))

# shot stopping per game for the focus team's keepers
gk_game <- shot_seq %>%
  filter(TeamName == Match_Away, on_target | Goal) %>%
  group_by(game_name) %>%
  summarise(`xGOT faced` = sum(xgot), Conceded = sum(Goal), SoT = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  right_join(games %>% select(game_name, Game_No, Game_Label), by = "game_name") %>%
  mutate(across(c(`xGOT faced`, Conceded, SoT), ~ coalesce(.x, 0)),
         Prevented = `xGOT faced` - Conceded,
         Game_Label = factor(Game_Label, levels = game_levels)) %>%
  arrange(Game_No) %>%
  mutate(Cum_Prevented = cumsum(Prevented))
gk_keepers <- gk_ev %>% filter(TeamName == Match_Home) %>% count(playerId, sort = TRUE) %>% pull(playerId) %>% short_name()

# ---- game-state selector -------------------------------------------
# Each chart/table on the analysis pages is drawn once per game state and
# shown with buttons (All, Winning, Drawing, Losing, Garbage Time). "All" runs
# the chart's code as normal; the other states run the same code in an
# environment where every data frame with a Game_State column is filtered to
# that state and the page's setup chunks are re-run, so tables and charts
# built from them follow the state. Game state is from the focus team's view.
game_states <- list(All = NULL, Winning = "Winning", Drawing = "Draw", Losing = "Losing",
                    `Garbage Time` = c("Garbage Time (winning)", "Garbage Time (losing)"))
.state_cache <- new.env()

state_env <- function(state, setup) {
  key <- paste(c(state, setup), collapse = "|")
  if (!identical(.state_cache$setup, setup)) {          # new page: drop the last page's copies
    rm(list = ls(.state_cache), envir = .state_cache)
    .state_cache$setup <- setup
  }
  if (!is.null(.state_cache[[key]])) return(.state_cache[[key]])
  env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
  keep <- game_states[[state]]
  for (nm in ls(globalenv())) {
    obj <- get(nm, envir = globalenv())
    if (is.data.frame(obj) && "Game_State" %in% names(obj)) {
      assign(nm, obj[obj$Game_State %in% keep, , drop = FALSE], envir = env)
    }
  }
  assign("Match_Fixture", paste0(Match_Fixture, " | ", state), envir = env)
  for (lab in setup) {
    code <- knitr::knit_code$get(lab)
    if (length(code)) {
      try(suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(eval(parse(text = code), envir = env))), silent = TRUE)
    }
  }
  .state_cache[[key]] <- env
  env
}

run_chunk_code <- function(label, env) {
  exprs <- parse(text = knitr::knit_code$get(label))
  outs <- list()
  for (e in exprs) {
    # anything the code prints (e.g. column names) is dropped, as only charts and tables are shown
    utils::capture.output(r <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(withVisible(eval(e, envir = env)))))
    if (r$visible && !is.null(r$value)) outs[[length(outs) + 1]] <- r$value
  }
  outs
}

as_selector_html <- function(x, width, height, dpi = 120, file_stub = NULL) {
  if (inherits(x, "ggplot") || inherits(x, "patchwork")) {
    # saved beside the dashboard's other figures and linked (not embedded), so the
    # page stays small: very large embedded images broke Quarto's card layout
    fig_dir <- knitr::opts_current$get("fig.path")
    if (is.null(fig_dir) || !nzchar(fig_dir)) fig_dir <- "figure-html/"
    if (is.null(file_stub)) file_stub <- basename(tempfile("state-"))
    f <- paste0(fig_dir, file_stub, ".png")
    dir.create(dirname(f), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(ggsave(f, x, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "snow")))
    # natural size (96 px per inch, as knitr's own figures) so flow rows size the cards as before
    return(htmltools::tags$img(src = f, loading = "lazy",
                               style = paste0("width:", round(width * 96), "px;max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;")))
  }
  if (inherits(x, "gt_tbl")) {
    # gt's own scoped CSS (white table body), as when a table is printed normally
    return(htmltools::div(style = "background:#FFFFFF;color:#333333;",
                          htmltools::HTML(gt::as_raw_html(x, inline_css = FALSE))))
  }
  if (inherits(x, "htmlwidget") || inherits(x, "shiny.tag") || inherits(x, "shiny.tag.list")) return(x)
  if (is.character(x)) return(htmltools::HTML(paste(x, collapse = "\n")))
  NULL
}

state_selector <- function(label, setup = character(0), width = 7, height = 5,
                           color = Color_Home, text_color = Color_Home_Text) {
  id <- paste0("st-", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "-", label))
  panels <- lapply(names(game_states), function(s) {
    content <- tryCatch({
      env <- if (s == "All") globalenv() else state_env(s, setup)
      outs <- run_chunk_code(label, env)
      parts <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(seq_along(outs), function(k)
        as_selector_html(outs[[k]], width = width, height = height,
                         file_stub = paste0(id, "-", gsub("[^A-Za-z]", "", s), "-", k))))
      if (length(parts) == 0) stop("no output")
      parts
    }, error = function(e) {
      list(htmltools::p(style = "padding:1rem;color:#555;", `data-error` = gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", gsub("\033\\[[0-9;]*m", "", conditionMessage(e))),
                        if (s == "All") "This chart could not be drawn." else
                          paste0("Not enough ", tolower(s), " minutes this season to draw this.")))
    })
    htmltools::div(class = "st-panel", `data-state` = s,
                   style = if (s != "All") "display:none;" else NULL, content)
  })
  btns <- lapply(names(game_states), function(s) {
    htmltools::tags$button(s, type = "button", `data-state` = s,
                           class = if (s == "All") "st-btn active" else "st-btn")
  })
  out <- htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::tags$style(htmltools::HTML(
      ".state-selector .st-btns{display:flex !important;flex-direction:row !important;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.35rem;margin-bottom:.5rem}
       .state-selector .st-btn{width:auto !important;flex:0 0 auto !important;margin:0;border:1px solid var(--st-col);background:#fff;color:var(--st-col);
         border-radius:999px;padding:.2rem .8rem;font-size:.85rem;cursor:pointer}
       .state-selector .st-btn.active{background:var(--st-col);color:var(--st-txt);font-weight:600}")),
    htmltools::div(
      id = id, class = "state-selector",
      style = paste0("--st-col:", color, ";--st-txt:", text_color, ";"),
      htmltools::div(class = "st-btns", btns),
      panels,
      htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML(sprintf(
        "(function(){var r=document.getElementById('%s');if(!r)return;
          r.querySelectorAll('.st-btn').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){
            var s=b.getAttribute('data-state');
            r.querySelectorAll('.st-btn').forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('active',x===b);});
            r.querySelectorAll('.st-panel').forEach(function(p){p.style.display=(p.getAttribute('data-state')===s)?'':'none';});
            window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
          });});})();", id)))
    )
  )
  # one block of HTML with no blank lines: a blank line (e.g. inside a table's CSS)
  # would end Quarto's raw-HTML block and break the card layout around it
  rt <- htmltools::renderTags(out)
  html <- gsub("\n[[:space:]]*\n", "\n", rt$html)
  htmltools::attachDependencies(htmltools::HTML(html), rt$dependencies)
}

# ---- form (last 5 vs season) and home vs away -------------------------
form_n <- 5
lower_better <- c("Goals against", "xG against", "Shots against", "EPV against", "PPDA", "Opp. field tilt %")
game_kpis <- game_stats %>%
  select(game_name, Game_No, Venue, TeamName, Goals, xG, Shots, EPV, PPDA, `Field tilt %`, `Possession %`) %>%
  mutate(side = ifelse(TeamName == Match_Home, "for", "against")) %>%
  select(-TeamName) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = side, values_from = c(Goals, xG, Shots, EPV, PPDA, `Field tilt %`, `Possession %`)) %>%
  left_join(entries %>% filter(box_entry, TeamName == Match_Home) %>% count(game_name, name = "Box entries"), by = "game_name") %>%
  left_join(def_shape_game %>% filter(TeamName == Match_Home) %>% select(game_name, `DA height (m)`), by = "game_name") %>%
  transmute(game_name, Game_No, Venue,
            Goals = Goals_for, `Goals against` = Goals_against,
            xG = xG_for, `xG against` = xG_against,
            Shots = Shots_for, `Shots against` = Shots_against,
            EPV = EPV_for, `EPV against` = EPV_against,
            PPDA = PPDA_for, `Field tilt %` = `Field tilt %_for`, `Possession %` = `Possession %_for`,
            `Box entries` = coalesce(as.numeric(`Box entries`), 0), `DA height (m)`) %>%
  arrange(Game_No)
kpi_names <- setdiff(names(game_kpis), c("game_name", "Game_No", "Venue"))

form_compare <- bind_rows(
  game_kpis %>% summarise(across(all_of(kpi_names), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>% mutate(Window = "Season"),
  game_kpis %>% slice_tail(n = form_n) %>% summarise(across(all_of(kpi_names), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    mutate(Window = paste0("Last ", min(form_n, nrow(game_kpis))))
) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(kpi_names), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Window, values_from = Value) %>%
  setNames(c("Metric", "Season", "Recent")) %>%
  mutate(Better = ifelse(Metric %in% lower_better, Recent < Season, Recent > Season),
         Group = ifelse(Metric %in% c("Goals against", "xG against", "Shots against", "EPV against", "PPDA", "DA height (m)"),
                        "Without the ball", "With the ball"))

venue_table <- game_kpis %>%
  group_by(Venue = ifelse(Venue == "H", "Home", "Away")) %>%
  summarise(Games = n(), across(all_of(kpi_names), ~ round(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(games %>% group_by(Venue = ifelse(Venue == "H", "Home", "Away")) %>%
              summarise(Record = paste0(sum(Result == "W"), "W ", sum(Result == "D"), "D ", sum(Result == "L"), "L"),
                        Points = 3 * sum(Result == "W") + sum(Result == "D"), .groups = "drop"),
            by = "Venue") %>%
  mutate(`Points per game` = round(Points / Games, 2)) %>%
  select(Venue, Games, Record, `Points per game`, all_of(kpi_names)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Venue, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value", values_transform = as.character) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Venue, values_from = Value) %>%
  select(Metric, any_of(c("Home", "Away")))
```

# League

```{r}
#| include: false
# league page helpers (not filtered by game state: the league view is the whole season)
League_Label <- paste0(League_Name, " | all ", n_league_teams, " clubs, games to ",
                       format(max(league_table$Last_Game, na.rm = TRUE), "%d-%m-%Y"))
league_scatter <- function(df, xvar, yvar, title, subtitle, xlab, ylab,
                           reverse_x = FALSE, reverse_y = FALSE, diagonal = FALSE) {
  d <- df %>% mutate(.x = .data[[xvar]], .y = .data[[yvar]], Focus = Team == Match_Home)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(.x, .y)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean(d$.x, na.rm = TRUE), colour = "grey60", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = mean(d$.y, na.rm = TRUE), colour = "grey60", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3)
  if (diagonal) p <- p + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3)
  p <- p +
    geom_point(data = d %>% filter(!Focus), colour = "grey55", fill = "grey80", shape = 21, size = 2.4) +
    geom_point(data = d %>% filter(Focus), colour = "black", fill = Color_Home, shape = 21, size = 4) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = Team, colour = Focus, fontface = ifelse(Focus, "bold", "plain")),
                             size = 2.2, min.segment.length = 0.2, seed = 1, max.overlaps = 30,
                             show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = Color_Home, `FALSE` = "grey30"), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = paste0(League_Label, " | ", subtitle), x = xlab, y = ylab, caption = My_caption) +
    line_theme()
  if (reverse_x) p <- p + scale_x_reverse()
  if (reverse_y) p <- p + scale_y_reverse()
  p
}
```


## Row {.flow}
### row {.tabset}
```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 10
#| title: Summary tables - Average
#| label: Summary tables a
MatchSummarySeasonTable <- MatchSummarySeasonData %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Team") %>%
  cols_hide('On Ball Time') %>%
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = everything()) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Season Summary - Full Games**"),
    subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture)) %>%
  tab_source_note(md(My_caption)) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(3, 14:17),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  fmt_percent(
    columns = c(2, 6, 19, 22, 24, 26, 30),
    decimals = 1,
    scale_values = FALSE
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = Color_Away_Text), cell_fill(color = Color_Away)),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = Match_Away)) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = Color_Home_Text), cell_fill(color = Color_Home)),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = Match_Home)) %>%
  tab_options(
    heading.padding = px(1),
    heading.align = "left",
    column_labels.background.color = "#E5E5E5",
    row_group.background.color = "#B22222",
    stub.background.color = "#E5E5E5",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black",
    summary_row.background.color = "#E5E5E5",
    table.font.size = 14,
    heading.title.font.size = 16,
    heading.subtitle.font.size = 14,
    source_notes.font.size = 8,
    table.width = "100%") %>%
  tab_style(locations = cells_title(groups = "title"),style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", size = 16))) 
MatchSummarySeasonTable
```

```{r}
#| output: false
#| label: Match MC setup
#Load data
dashboard_data <- plottingData

#Dashboard data wrangling all data
dashboard_data <- dashboard_data %>%
  filter(Team_Group == Match_Home) %>%
      filter(period != 5) %>%
  filter(TotalShots == 1) %>%
  filter(!situation == "NA") %>%
  mutate(TotalxG = cumsum(xG)) %>%
  mutate(TotalNPxG = cumsum(NPxG)) %>%
  mutate(TotalxGOT = cumsum(xGOT)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_X = ifelse(str_detect(Goals, "1"), paste0(expandedMinute), NA)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_Y = ifelse(str_detect(Goals, "1"), paste0(TotalxG), NA)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_X = as.numeric(Goal_point_X)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_Y = as.numeric(Goal_point_Y)) %>%
  select(x, y, Goal_point_Y, Goal_point_X, TotalxG, TotalNPxG, TotalxGOT, situation, TeamName, TotalShots, xG, NPxG, xGOT, expandedMinute, type, period, Game_Block, Game_State, Match_day)

#Oppo dashboard

Oppodashboard_data <- plottingData

Oppodashboard_data <- Oppodashboard_data %>%
  filter(Team_Group == Match_Away) %>%
      filter(period != 5) %>%
  filter(TotalShots == 1) %>%
  filter(!situation == "NA") %>%
  mutate(TotalxG = cumsum(xG)) %>%
  mutate(TotalNPxG = cumsum(NPxG)) %>%
  mutate(TotalxGOT = cumsum(xGOT)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_X = ifelse(str_detect(Goals, "1"), paste0(expandedMinute), NA)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_Y = ifelse(str_detect(Goals, "1"), paste0(TotalxG), NA)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_X = as.numeric(Goal_point_X)) %>%
  mutate(Goal_point_Y = as.numeric(Goal_point_Y)) %>%
  select(x, y, Goal_point_Y, Goal_point_X, TotalxG, TotalNPxG, TotalxGOT, situation, TeamName, TotalShots, xG, NPxG, xGOT, expandedMinute, type, period, Game_Block, Game_State, Match_day)

WinDashboard_data <- dashboard_data %>%
  filter(Game_State == "Winning") %>%
    filter(!period == 5) %>%
  filter(!Match_day == 0)
  

DrawDashboard_data <- dashboard_data %>%
  filter(Game_State == "Draw") %>%
    filter(period != 5) %>%
  filter(!Match_day == 0)

GTimeDashboard_data <- dashboard_data %>%
  filter(Game_State %in% c("Garbage Time (winning)", "Garbage Time (losing)")) %>%
    filter(period != 5) %>%
  filter(!Match_day == 0)

WinOppoDashboard_data <- Oppodashboard_data %>%
  filter(Game_State == "Winning") %>%
    filter(period != 5) %>%
  filter(!Match_day == 0)

DrawOppoDashboard_data <- Oppodashboard_data %>%
  filter(Game_State == "Draw") %>%
    filter(period != 5) %>%
  filter(!Match_day == 0)

GTimeOppoDashboard_data <- Oppodashboard_data %>%
  filter(Game_State %in% c("Garbage Time (winning)", "Garbage Time (losing)")) %>%
    filter(period != 5) %>%
  filter(!Match_day == 0)


HomexGMC <- HomeShots <- dashboard_data %>%
  select(xG)
AwayxGMC <- AwayShots <- Oppodashboard_data %>%
  select(xG)

#calculate match actual goals
HomeTotalGoals <- sum(!is.na(ifelse(dashboard_data$type == "Goal", 1, NA)))
AwayTotalGoals <- sum(!is.na(ifelse(Oppodashboard_data$type == "Goal", 1, NA)))
```

```{r}
#| label: ss-season-summary-pre-1


# Set up for monte carlo --------------------------------------------------

#Goals Against
set.seed(1111) # if you set the same seed, you will get the same output

runs = 1000; # change based on how many simulation runs you want

AwayxGMC_output <- numeric(runs) # makes a vector to put data in (good practice for when you start building really big simulations)

#Goals for
set.seed(1111) # if you set the same seed, you will get the same output

runs = 1000; # change based on how many simulation runs you want

HomexGMC_output <- numeric(runs)


# monte carlo simulation --------------------------------------------------

#goals Away team
for (i in 1:runs) {
  temp_game <- vapply(AwayxGMC$xG, function(x) as.numeric(rbinom(1, 1, x)), numeric(1)) # apply applies the function to each row, and gives backs the output as a vector
  AwayxGMC_output[i] <- sum(temp_game)
}

# proportion of certain goals -------------------------------------------- (overall 17 ga, 28g, home 21g 8 ga, away 7g 9 ga)

goals <- AwayTotalGoals # set number of goals you want proportion for

number_goals <- sum(AwayxGMC_output == goals) # number of times those goals were "scored" out of the number of runs

at_least_goals <- sum(AwayxGMC_output >= goals) # at least that many goals

#table(AwayxGMC_output)


# monte carlo simulation --------------------------------------------------
#Goals Home
for (i in 1:runs) {
  temp_game <- vapply(HomexGMC$xG, function(x) as.numeric(rbinom(1, 1, x)), numeric(1)) # apply applies the function to each row, and gives backs the output as a vector
  HomexGMC_output[i] <- sum(temp_game)
}

# proportion of certain goals -------------------------------------------- (use totals for block)

goals <- HomeTotalGoals # set number of goals you want proportion for

number_goals <- sum(HomexGMC_output == goals) # number of times those goals were "scored" out of the number of runs

at_least_goals <- sum(HomexGMC_output >= goals) # at least that many goals

#table(HomexGMC_output)


# create data frame from the MC output, so converting vector into data frame
MC_output <- data.frame(HomexGMC_output, AwayxGMC_output)

MD_MC <- MC_output %>%
  select(Home = HomexGMC_output, Away = AwayxGMC_output)


prob_matrix <- table(MD_MC$Home, MD_MC$Away) / runs


# Assuming you have the 'prob_matrix' from the previous example

# Convert probability matrix to long format for ggplot
long_prob_matrix <- as.data.frame(as.table(prob_matrix))
colnames(long_prob_matrix) <- c("Home", "Away", "Probability")

long_prob_matrix <- long_prob_matrix %>%
  mutate(Probability = round(Probability, 2)*100)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
#| label: Match probablity calculations

# Calculate probabilities for different outcomes
Away_wins_prob <- (sum(prob_matrix[upper.tri(prob_matrix)])*100)
Home_wins_prob <- (sum(prob_matrix[lower.tri(prob_matrix)])*100)
tie_prob <- (sum(diag(prob_matrix))*100)

# Create a data frame for bar chart
outcome_prob <- data.frame(Outcome = c(Match_Home, "Match Drawn", Match_Away),
                           Probability = c(Home_wins_prob, tie_prob, Away_wins_prob))

outcome_prob <- outcome_prob %>%
  mutate(Probability = round(Probability,2))

# Define custom colors
custom_colors <- c(Match_Home = Color_Home, "Match Drawn" = "gray", Match_Away = Color_Away)

```

```{r}
#| label: ss-season-summary-pre-2
#calculate match actual goals
#Matchday MC
HomexGMC <- HomeShots <- dashboard_data %>%
  select(xG)
AwayxGMC <- AwayShots <- Oppodashboard_data %>%
  select(xG)

#calculate match actual goals
HomeTotalGoals <- sum(!is.na(ifelse(dashboard_data$type == "Goal", 1, NA)))
AwayTotalGoals <- sum(!is.na(ifelse(Oppodashboard_data$type == "Goal", 1, NA)))


#run MC for Match outcomes and Match Score proablity
sim_results <- simulate_match_outcomes(home_xg_vector = HomexGMC, away_xg_vector = AwayxGMC, seed = 1111, runs = 10000, actual_home_goals = HomeTotalGoals, actual_away_goals = AwayTotalGoals)

# Calculate probabilities for different outcomes
Away_wins_prob <- (sum(sim_results$prob_matrix[upper.tri(sim_results$prob_matrix)])*100)
Home_wins_prob <- (sum(sim_results$prob_matrix[lower.tri(sim_results$prob_matrix)])*100)
tie_prob <- (sum(diag(sim_results$prob_matrix))*100)

# Create a data frame for Match outcome bar chart
outcome_prob <- data.frame(Outcome = c(Match_Home, "Match Drawn", Match_Away),
                           Probability = c(Home_wins_prob, tie_prob, Away_wins_prob))

outcome_prob <- outcome_prob %>%
  mutate(Probability = round(Probability, 2))

#create data frame for Match score tile plot
long_prob_matrix <- sim_results$long_prob_matrix

#redo factor to numeric the score probablity
long_prob_matrix <- long_prob_matrix %>%
  mutate(Home = as.numeric(as.character(Home)),
         Away = as.numeric(as.character(Away)))


# Define custom colors
custom_colors <- c(Match_Home = Color_Home, "Match Drawn" = "gray", Match_Away = Color_Away)

```

```{r}
TotalGA <- sum(!is.na(ifelse(OppoShotsALL$type == "Goal", 1, NA)))

TotalGA_OG <- og_by(Match_Away, unique(OppoShotsALL$Game_State))

B1TotalGA <- sum(!is.na(ifelse(OppoShotsB1$type == "Goal", 1, NA)))
B1TotalGoals_OG <- og_by(Match_Home, unique(LFCShotsB1$Game_State))
B1TotalGA_OG <- og_by(Match_Away, unique(OppoShotsB1$Game_State))



#set final goal total

Season_G <- sum(TotalGoals + TotalGA_OG)
Season_GA <- sum(TotalGA + TotalGoals_OG)

B1_G <- sum(B1TotalGoals + B1TotalGA_OG)
B1_GA <- sum(B1TotalGA + B1TotalGoals_OG)

  select(xG)

                 <span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:{Color_Home};font-size:16px;'>For</span>
                 <span style='font-family:\"Arial\";color:gray12;font-size:16px;'>and</span>
                 <span style='font-family:\"Arial Bold\";color:{Color_Away};font-size:16px;'>Against</span>
                 <span style='color:gray12;font-size:16px;'>)</span>"))

runs = 1000; # change based on how many simulation runs you want

SeasonxGA_output <- numeric(runs) # makes a vector to put data in (good practice for when you start building really big simulations)

#Goals for

runs = 1000; # change based on how many simulation runs you want

# monte carlo simulation --------------------------------------------------

#goals Against
for (i in 1:runs) {
  temp_game <- vapply(OppoShotsSeason$xGA, function(x) as.numeric(rbinom(1, 1, x)), numeric(1)) # apply applies the function to each row, and gives backs the output as a vector
  SeasonxGA_output[i] <- sum(temp_game)
}

# proportion of certain goals -------------------------------------------- (overall 17 ga, 28g, home 21g 8 ga, away 7g 9 ga)

goals <- Season_GA # set number of goals you want proportion for

number_goals <- sum(SeasonxGA_output == goals) # number of times those goals were "scored" out of the number of runs

at_least_goals <- sum(SeasonxGA_output >= goals) # at least that many goals

table(SeasonxGA_output)

at_least_goals <- sum(SeasonxG_output >= goals) # at least that many goals

table(SeasonxG_output)
```

```{r}
Home_wins_prob <- (sum(prob_matrixB1[lower.tri(prob_matrixB1)])*100)
```

```{r}
#| label: ss-passing-analysis-setup-1

# Step 1: Filter successful passes open play only
successful_passes <- plottingData 
successful_passesB1 <- plottingDataB1 
successful_passesB2 <- plottingDataB2 
successful_passesB3 <- plottingDataB3 

# Step 2: Identify passing sequences with more than the defined level of pass

passing_sequencesLFC <- successful_passes %>%
  mutate(
    pass_count = ifelse(Successful_Passes == 1 & TeamName == Match_Home, 1, 0),
    passing_seq = accumulate(Successful_Passes == 1 & TeamName == Match_Home, ~ifelse(.y == 0, .y, .x + .y)),
    Pchain = cumsum(passing_seq == 0) + 1,
    pass_count = cumsum(pass_count)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Pchain) %>%
  mutate(
    Distance_seq = ifelse(passing_seq > 0, cumsum(Distance_Metre),0),
    PChain_pass_count = max(passing_seq),
    PChain_distance_count = ifelse(passing_seq > 0, sum(Distance_Metre),0),
    PDistance = ifelse(passing_seq > 0, Distance_Metre, 0),
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    minute, second, Team_Group, playerId, type, `type/value`, outcome, `outcomeType/value`, pass_count, passing_seq, Pchain, PChain_pass_count, x, y, Distance_Metre, PDistance, Distance_seq, PChain_distance_count, Game_Period, Game_Block, period, Game_State, Match_day
  ) %>%
  mutate(Pchain_Length = ifelse(PChain_pass_count <= 5, "VLow",
                                ifelse(PChain_pass_count <= 10 & PChain_pass_count > 5.5, "Low",
                                       ifelse(PChain_pass_count <= 15 & PChain_pass_count > 10.5, "Medium",
                                              ifelse(PChain_pass_count > 15.5, "High", NA))))) %>%
  mutate(PchainN = cumsum(passing_seq == 0) + 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: ss-passing-analysis-3
#| include: false
#| eval: false
#passing chains all in
passing_sequencesLFC_Plot <- passing_sequencesLFC %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, group = Pchain)) +
  annotate_pitch(dimensions = pitch_opta, fill = "#E5E5E5", colour = "#95A5A6") +
  theme_pitch() +
  geom_segment(aes(y = 21.1, yend = 21.1, x = 0, xend = 100), linewidth = 0.3, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  geom_segment(aes(y = 36.8, yend = 36.8, x = 0, xend = 100), linewidth = 0.3, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  geom_segment(aes(y = 63.2, yend = 63.2, x = 0, xend = 100), linewidth = 0.3, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  geom_segment(aes(y = 78.9, yend = 78.9, x = 0, xend = 100), linewidth = 0.3, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  geom_segment(aes(y = 0, yend = 100, x = 17, xend = 17), linewidth = 0.3, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  geom_segment(aes(y = 0, yend = 100, x = 33.2, xend = 33.2), linewidth = 0.3, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  geom_segment(aes(y = 0, yend = 100, x = 50, xend = 50), linewidth = 0.3, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  geom_segment(aes(y = 0, yend = 100, x = 66.4, xend = 66.4), linewidth = 0.3, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  geom_segment(aes(y = 0, yend = 100, x = 83, xend = 83), linewidth = 0.3, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  
  # add zone numbers
  geom_text(aes(y = 50, x = 74.7, label = "14"), size = 1, color = "grey", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(y = 71.05, x = 74.7, label = "LHS"), size = 1, color = "grey", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(y = 28.95, x = 74.7, label = "RHS"), size = 1, color = "grey", show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  geom_path(color = passing_sequencesLFC$Pchain) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = lead(x), yend = lead(y)),
    arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.1, "cm")),
    lineend = "round",
    linewidth = 0.1,
    color = passing_sequencesLFC$Pchain
  ) +
  facet_grid(factor(Pchain_Length, levels = c("VLow", "Low", "Medium", "High")) ~ Game_Period) +
  labs(title = paste0(Match_Home, " Passing Chain Length (5, 6-10, 11-15, 16 +) by Game Period"), 
       subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture),
       caption = My_caption) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12),
        plot.caption = element_markdown(),
        plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(size = 6, colour = Color_Home_Text),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = Color_Home, color = "black", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1))

passing_sequencesLFC_Plot
```

```{r}
state_selector("ss-passing-analysis-3", setup = page_setup_passing_analysis, width = 7, height = 5)
```

```{r}
    mutate(Half = ifelse(period == 1, "First Half",
```

```{r}
ai_gt(sp_summary, "Set Pieces - Season", group = "Section", rowname = "Metric") %>%
  gt_team_spanners() %>%
  fmt_number(columns = ends_with("Per game"), decimals = 2) %>%
  tab_footnote("First contact: the team that touches the ball first after the delivery (aerial duels go to the winner). Rate = first contact won / throw-ins retained / set-piece share of xG.")
```

```{r}
#| title: Shots by Situation
#| label: season shots by situation
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| fig-dpi: 150

sit <- shot_seq %>%
  group_by(TeamName, Class) %>%
  summarise(Shots = n(), xG = sum(xg), Goals = sum(Goal), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(TeamName = factor(TeamName, levels = c(Match_Home, Match_Away)),
         Class = factor(Class, levels = c("Open play", "Set piece", "Penalty")))

ggplot(sit, aes(x = Class, y = xG / n_games, fill = TeamName)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, colour = "#454545", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(f2(xG / n_games), "\n(", Goals, " g)")), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
            vjust = -0.2, size = 2.2, lineheight = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = team_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
  labs(title = "xG per Game by Situation",
       subtitle = paste0(Season_Label, " | label = xG per game (season goals)"),
       x = NULL, y = "xG per game", caption = My_caption) +
  line_theme()
```

```{r}
#| title: Corners
#| label: season home corner deliveries
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| fig-dpi: 150

plot_sp_deliveries <- function(team, sp_kind) {
  d <- sp_events %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team, sp_type %in% .env$sp_kind, !is.na(end_x))
  fc_cols <- c(Won = col_success, Lost = col_fail, `No contact` = "grey45")
  ggplot(d) +
    pitch_base() +
    geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = end_x, yend = end_y, colour = First_Contact,
                     linetype = ifelse(short, "Short", "Direct")),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "cm"), type = "closed"), linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.55) +
    geom_point(aes(x = end_x, y = end_y, colour = First_Contact), size = 0.9, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = fc_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Direct = "solid", Short = "dashed")) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(50, 100)) +
    pitch_title(paste0(team, " ", paste(sp_kind, collapse = " & "), " Deliveries - First Contact"),
                paste0(Season_Label, " | ", nrow(d), " deliveries, ", sum(d$First_Contact == "Won"),
                       " first contacts won (", pct_txt(sum(d$First_Contact == "Won"), nrow(d)), ") | dashed = short"))
}
plot_sp_deliveries(Match_Home, "Corner")
```

## Shot-Creating Sequences {.flow}
### Home {.tabset}
```{r}
#| title: Where Sequences Started
#| label: season home sequence starts
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| fig-dpi: 150

seq_shapes <- c(`Open-play regain` = 16, Keeper = 15, `Goal kick` = 0, `Throw-in` = 2,
                `Free kick` = 17, Corner = 4, `Kick-off` = 8)
plot_sequence_starts <- function(team) {
  d <- shot_seq %>% filter(TeamName == team, !is.na(start_x))
  ggplot(d) +
    pitch_base() +
    geom_point(aes(x = start_x, y = start_y, shape = start_type, size = xg),
               colour = team_col(team), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = d %>% filter(Goal), aes(x = start_x, y = start_y), shape = 21, size = 3.2,
               fill = NA, colour = "black", stroke = 0.8) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = seq_shapes, name = "Started from") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.6, 3.5), guide = "none") +
    pitch_title(paste0(team, " - Where Shot-Creating Sequences Started"),
                paste0(Season_Label, " | one marker per shot at the start of its sequence, sized by xG; ringed = goal"))
}
plot_sequence_starts(Match_Home)
```

```{r}
#| title: Sequence Summary
#| label: season home sequence summary

seq_summary_table <- function(team) {
  d <- shot_seq %>% filter(TeamName == team) %>%
    group_by(`Started from` = start_type) %>%
    summarise(Shots = n(), `Shots per game` = round(n() / n_games, 2), xG = round(sum(xg), 2),
              Goals = sum(Goal), `xG per shot` = round(mean(xg), 3),
              `Median passes` = median(Passes, na.rm = TRUE), `Median duration (s)` = median(Duration, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(xG))
  ai_gt(d, paste0(team, " - Shot-Creating Sequences by Start")) %>%
    gt_color_rows(columns = "xG", palette = team_scale(team), domain = c(0, max(c(d$xG, 1)))) %>%
    tab_footnote("Passes and duration count from the first event of the sequence to the shot.")
}
seq_summary_table(Match_Home)
```

## Entry Maps {.flow}
### Home {.tabset}
```{r}
#| title: Box Entries
#| label: season home box entry map
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| fig-dpi: 150

# a season has hundreds of entries, so show where they start (hex density)
# and where they land (dots), rather than one arrow each
plot_entry_density <- function(team, flag, label) {
  d <- entries %>% filter(TeamName == team, .data[[flag]])
  ggplot(d) +
    pitch_base() +
    geom_bin_2d(aes(x = x, y = y), bins = 18, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_point(aes(x = end_x, y = end_y), colour = "black", size = 0.25, alpha = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FFFAFA", high = team_col(team), name = "Entries started") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = if (flag == "box_entry") c(40, 100) else c(20, 100)) +
    pitch_title(paste0(team, " ", label),
                paste0(Season_Label, " | shading = where entries started, dots = where they ended | ",
                       round(nrow(d) / n_games, 1), " per game, ", pct_txt(sum(d$Success), nrow(d)), " successful")) +
    theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 6))
}
plot_entry_density(Match_Home, "box_entry", "Box Entries")
```

```{r}
#player summary tables

MatchSummaryPLayerData <- plottingData %>%
  mutate(
    Out_of_play_time = round(Out_of_play_time / 60, 1),
    EventTime = round(EventTime / 60, 1),
    TeamEPV = as.numeric(ifelse(str_detect(`outcomeType/value`, "1"), paste0(EPVvalue), 0))) %>%
  group_by(TeamName, playerId, Team_Group, role) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(Goals, TotalShots, 'OFT Shots' = OFShots, 'OT Shots' = OTShots, Out_Box_Shots, Touches, PK_Box_Touches, Attempted_Passes, Successful_Passes, TeamEPV, Key_Passes, Assists, Hockey_Assists, BCs, xG, xGOT, Aerial_total, Aerial_Won, Aerial_Lost, Ground_Duels_Total, Ground_Duels_Won, Ground_Duels_Lost), list(sum), na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Team_Group) %>%
  mutate(
    Team_TotalTouches = sum(Touches),
    Team_TotalEPV = sum(TeamEPV),
    Team_TotalxG = sum(xG),
    Team_TotalPasses = sum(Attempted_Passes),
    Team_TotalDuels = sum(Ground_Duels_Total),
    Team_TotalAerials = sum(Aerial_total),
    Team_TotalShots = sum(TotalShots),
    Possession = round((Touches / Team_TotalTouches) * 100, 1),
    Pass_Success = round((Successful_Passes / Attempted_Passes) * 100, 1),
    Aerial_Success = round((Aerial_Won / Aerial_total) * 100, 1),
    Duel_Success = round((Ground_Duels_Won / Ground_Duels_Total) * 100, 1),
    On_Ball_Time = round(InPlayTime * (Possession / 100), 1),
    Team_EPV_P = round((TeamEPV / Team_TotalEPV) * 100, 1),
    Team_xG_P = round((xG / Team_TotalxG) * 100, 1),
    Team_Duels_P = round((Ground_Duels_Total / Team_TotalDuels) * 100, 1),
    Team_Aerial_P = round((Aerial_total / Team_TotalAerials) * 100, 1),
    Team_Passes_P = round((Attempted_Passes / Team_TotalPasses) * 100, 1),
    Team_Shots_P = round((TotalShots / Team_TotalShots) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  #replace_na(list( Aerial_Success = 0)) %>%
  #replace_na(list( Duel_Success = 0)) %>%
  filter(role != is.na(role)) %>%
  ungroup()

MatchSummarySeasonPlayerData <- plottingData %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Out_of_play_time = Out_of_play_time / 60,
    EventTime        = EventTime / 60,
    TeamEPV          = as.numeric(dplyr::if_else(
                         stringr::str_detect(`outcomeType/value`, "1"),
                         EPVvalue, 0
                       ))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(TeamName, playerId, Team_Group, role) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_matches = dplyr::n_distinct(game_name),
    dplyr::across(
      c(
        Goals, TotalShots, OFShots, OTShots, Out_Box_Shots,
        Touches, PK_Box_Touches,
        Attempted_Passes, Successful_Passes, TeamEPV,
        Key_Passes, Assists, Hockey_Assists, BCs,
        xG, xGOT,
        Aerial_total, Aerial_Won, Aerial_Lost,
        Ground_Duels_Total, Ground_Duels_Won, Ground_Duels_Lost
      ),
      ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE) / n_matches
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-n_matches) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Team_Group) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Team_TotalTouches = sum(Touches, na.rm = TRUE),
    Team_TotalEPV     = sum(TeamEPV, na.rm = TRUE),
    Team_TotalxG      = sum(xG, na.rm = TRUE),
    Team_TotalPasses  = sum(Attempted_Passes, na.rm = TRUE),
    Team_TotalDuels   = sum(Ground_Duels_Total, na.rm = TRUE),
    Team_TotalAerials = sum(Aerial_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    Team_TotalShots   = sum(TotalShots, na.rm = TRUE),

    Possession        = (Touches / Team_TotalTouches) * 100,
    Pass_Success      = (Successful_Passes / Attempted_Passes) * 100,
    Aerial_Success    = (Aerial_Won / Aerial_total) * 100,
    Duel_Success      = (Ground_Duels_Won / Ground_Duels_Total) * 100,
    On_Ball_Time      = InPlayTime * (Possession / 100),  # assumes InPlayTime exists upstream

    Team_EPV_P        = (TeamEPV / Team_TotalEPV) * 100,
    Team_xG_P         = (xG / Team_TotalxG) * 100,
    Team_Duels_P      = (Ground_Duels_Total / Team_TotalDuels) * 100,
    Team_Aerial_P     = (Aerial_total / Team_TotalAerials) * 100,
    Team_Passes_P     = (Attempted_Passes / Team_TotalPasses) * 100,
    Team_Shots_P      = (TotalShots / Team_TotalShots) * 100
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(role)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
```

```{r pass connections home}
#| output: false
# this copies the player name columna into a new column and shifts it up one to then be the reciever 
shift_column <- function(data, columns, new_names = sprintf("%s.Shifted", columns), len = 1L, up = TRUE) {
  if (length(columns) != length(new_names)) {
    stop("columns and new_names must be the same length")
  }
  
  # get the rows to keep based on how much to shift it by and weather to shift up or down
  rowsToKeep <- seq(from = 1 + len * up, length.out = NROW(data) - len)
  
  # for the original data -- it needs to be shifted the other way
  dataRowsToKeep <- seq(from = 1 + len * !up, length.out = NROW(data) - len)
  
  #create a df of the shifted rows
  shiftedDF <- data[rowsToKeep, columns]
  
  # give the right names to these new columns
  names(shiftedDF) <- new_names
  
  # data names
  dataNames <- names(data)
  
  # get rid of excess rows in data
  data <- data[dataRowsToKeep, ]
  
  # tack shifted data onto the end of the original (and cutoff) data
  data <- cbind(data, shiftedDF)
  names(data) <- c(dataNames, new_names)
  
  return(data)
  } 

PassConnections <- plottingData 
PassConnections <- PassConnections[complete.cases(PassConnections[, "playerId"]), ]
PassConnections <- PassConnections[complete.cases(PassConnections[, "TeamName"]), ]
PassConnections <- shift_column(data = PassConnections, columns = "playerId", new_names = "receiver", len = 1, up = TRUE)
PassConnections <- shift_column(data = PassConnections, columns = "TeamName", new_names = "receiver_team", len = 1, up = TRUE)


# number of passess between players
PassConnections <- PassConnections %>%
  filter(type == "Pass") %>% 
  select(Passer = playerId, Receiver = receiver, Passer_Team = TeamName, Receiver_Team = receiver_team, Successful_Passes, BCs, Key_Passes, Prog_Passes, EPV = EPVvalue) 

#calculate pass success
PassConnections <- PassConnections %>%
  group_by(Passer, Receiver, Passer_Team, Receiver_Team) %>% 
  summarise(Passes = n(), Successful_Passes = sum(Successful_Passes), Key_Passes = sum(Key_Passes), BCs = sum(BCs), Prog_Passes = sum(Prog_Passes), EPV = sum(EPV)) %>% 
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(Pass_Suc = (round(Successful_Passes / Passes,2)*100),
         EPV_P_Pass = (round(EPV / Successful_Passes, 3))) %>%
  replace_na(list(Pass_Suc = 0))

#filter by over 5 connections
PassConnections <- PassConnections %>%
  group_by(Passer = pmin(Passer, Passer), Receiver = pmax(Receiver, Receiver), Passer_Team, Receiver_Team) %>%
  filter(Passes >= 50) %>%
  summarise(Passes = sum(Passes), Successful_Passes = sum(Successful_Passes), Pass_Success = mean(Pass_Suc), Key_Passes = sum(Key_Passes), BCs = sum(BCs), Prog_Passes = sum(Prog_Passes), EPV = sum(EPV), EPV_P_Pass)

#prep for main tables
PassConnectiondata <- PassConnections %>%
  select(Passer_Team, Passer, Receiver, Receiver_Team, 'Attempted Passes' = Passes, 'Successful Passes' = Successful_Passes, 'Pass Success %' = Pass_Success, 'Key Passes' = Key_Passes, 'Prog Passes' = Prog_Passes, EPV, EPV_P_Pass)
```

```{r}
           `type/value` == 14 |
           `type/value` == 15 |
           `type/value` == 16 |
           `type/value` == 41 |
           `type/value` == 44 |
           `type/value` == 42 |
           `type/value` == 45 |

#set time period
EPVHeatMapDataFT <- EPVHeatMapData

# Calculte average player position
      Average_PlayerFT <- EPVHeatMapDataFT %>% 
        group_by(playerId, player_shirt) %>% 
        summarise(x = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), y = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE), events = n()) %>% 
        na.omit() %>%
        mutate(x = (100 - x),
               y = (100 - y))

#set EPV total for time period
HomeEPVFT <- sum(EPVHeatMapDataFT$EPVvalue)

# Create a new variable to represent the zone for each observation
EPVHeatMapDataFT$zone_x <- cut(EPVHeatMapDataFT$x, breaks = c(0, 17, 33.2, 50, 66.4, 83, 100), include.lowest = TRUE)
EPVHeatMapDataFT$zone_y <- cut(EPVHeatMapDataFT$y, breaks = c(0, 21.1, 36.8, 63.2, 78.9, 100), include.lowest = TRUE)

# Calculate average EPV for each zone
average_epvFT <- EPVHeatMapDataFT %>%
  group_by(zone_x, zone_y) %>%
  summarize(avg_epv = sum(EPVvalue, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(avg_epv = round(ifelse(avg_epv < 0, abs(avg_epv), avg_epv), 3),
         PEPV = round(avg_epv/HomeEPVFT,3))
```

```{r}
#| label: ss-epv-analysis-setup-4

#wrapped home plot
#set time period
EPVHeatMapDataFTW <- EPVHeatMapData

#set EPV total for time period
HomeEPVFTW <- sum(EPVHeatMapDataFTW$EPVvalue)

#set EPV total for time period by game period
HomeEPVFTGP <- EPVHeatMapDataFTW %>%
  group_by(Game_Period) %>%
  summarise(TEPVGP = sum(EPVvalue))

# Create a new variable to represent the zone for each observation
EPVHeatMapDataFTW$zone_x <- cut(EPVHeatMapDataFTW$x, breaks = c(0, 17, 33.2, 50, 66.4, 83, 100), include.lowest = TRUE)
EPVHeatMapDataFTW$zone_y <- cut(EPVHeatMapDataFTW$y, breaks = c(0, 21.1, 36.8, 63.2, 78.9, 100), include.lowest = TRUE)

# Calculate average EPV for each zone
average_epvFTW <- EPVHeatMapDataFTW %>%
  group_by(Game_Period, zone_x, zone_y) %>%
  summarize(avg_epv = sum(EPVvalue, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(avg_epv = round(ifelse(avg_epv < 0, abs(avg_epv), avg_epv), 3),
         PEPV = round(avg_epv/HomeEPVFTW,3)) 


#calculate for combined tile and heat map
average_epvNZFTW <- average_epvFTW %>%
  mutate(x = ifelse(zone_x == "[0,17]", 8.5,
                    ifelse(zone_x == "(17,33.2]", 25.1,
                           ifelse(zone_x == "(33.2,50]", 41.6,
                                  ifelse(zone_x == "(50,66.4]", 58.2,
                                         ifelse(zone_x == "(66.4,83]", 74.7,
                                                ifelse(zone_x == "(83,100]", 91.5, NA))))))) %>%
  mutate(y = ifelse(zone_y == "[0,21.1]", 10,
                    ifelse(zone_y == "(21.1,36.8]", 30,
                           ifelse(zone_y == "(36.8,63.2]", 50,
                                  ifelse(zone_y == "(63.2,78.9]", 70,
                                         ifelse(zone_y == "(78.9,100]", 90, NA))))))


average_epvNZFTW <- average_epvNZFTW %>%
  group_by(Game_Period, x, y) %>%
  summarise(avg_epv = sum(avg_epv, na.rm = TRUE)) 

average_epvNZFTW <- average_epvNZFTW %>%
  left_join(HomeEPVFTGP, by = c('Game_Period' = 'Game_Period'), copy = TRUE)

average_epvNZFTW <- average_epvNZFTW %>%
  mutate(PEPV = 100*(round(avg_epv/TEPVGP,2)))
```

```{r}
  geom_segment(aes(y = 0, yend = 100, x = 33.2, xend = 33.2), linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  geom_segment(aes(y = 0, yend = 100, x = 50, xend = 50), linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
```

``` {r}
DefEPVData <- shift_column(data = DefEPVData, columns = "EPVvalue", new_names = "Def_EPV", len = 1, up = TRUE)

DefEPVData <- DefEPVData %>%
  filter(Defensive_Action == 1) %>%
  select(Team_Group, TeamName, playerId, EPVvalue, Defensive_Action, outcome, Def_EPV, role) %>%
  mutate(Successful_Def_EPV = ifelse(str_detect(outcome, "Successful"), paste0(Def_EPV), 0)) %>%
  mutate(Unsuccessful_Def_EPV = ifelse(str_detect(outcome, "Unsuccessful"), paste0(Def_EPV), 0)) %>%
  mutate(Successful_Def_EPV = as.numeric(Successful_Def_EPV)) %>%
  mutate(Unsuccessful_Def_EPV = as.numeric(Unsuccessful_Def_EPV))

AwayDefEPVData <- DefEPVData %>%

HomeDefEPVData <- DefEPVData %>%
  filter(Team_Group == Match_Home)

#set EPV total for time period
HomeEPVFT <- sum(HomeDefEPVData$EPVvalue)
AwayEPVFT <- sum(AwayDefEPVData$EPVvalue)


  
HomeDefEPVData <- HomeDefEPVData %>%  
  mutate(Percent_of_Attacking_Team_total = round(Def_EPV/AwayEPVFT,3)) %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_Attacking_Team_Succ = round(Successful_Def_EPV/AwayEPVFT,3)) %>%
  #mutate(Percent_of_Attacking_Team_UnSucc = round(Unsuccessful_Def_EPV/AwayEPVFT,3))
  mutate(Percent_of_Attacking_Team_UnSucc = round(1- Percent_of_Attacking_Team_Succ,3)) 





AwayDefEPVData <- AwayDefEPVData %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_Attacking_Team_total = round(Def_EPV/HomeEPVFT,3)) %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_Attacking_Team_Succ = round(Successful_Def_EPV/HomeEPVFT,3)) %>%
  #mutate(Percent_of_Attacking_Team_UnSucc = round(Unsuccessful_Def_EPV/AwayEPVFT,3))
  mutate(Percent_of_Attacking_Team_UnSucc = round(1- Percent_of_Attacking_Team_Succ,3)) 



HomeDefEPVTable <- HomeDefEPVData %>%
    group_by(Player = playerId, role) %>% 
  summarise(EPV_Faced = sum(Def_EPV+EPVvalue), Percent_Attacking_Team_EPV = sum(Percent_of_Attacking_Team_total), EPV_Won = sum(Successful_Def_EPV/EPV_Faced), EPV_Lost = sum(Unsuccessful_Def_EPV/EPV_Faced)) %>%
    mutate_all(~ifelse(is.nan(.), 0, .))

AwayDefEPVTable <- AwayDefEPVData %>%
    group_by(Player = playerId, role) %>% 
  summarise(EPV_Faced = sum(Def_EPV+EPVvalue), Percent_Attacking_Team_EPV = sum(Percent_of_Attacking_Team_total), EPV_Won = sum(Successful_Def_EPV/EPV_Faced), EPV_Lost = sum(Unsuccessful_Def_EPV/EPV_Faced)) %>%
    mutate_all(~ifelse(is.nan(.), 0, .))
```
