```{r}
#| label: ss-ppda-analysis-setup-1
#| output: false
HomePPDAHeatMapData <- plottingData %>%
  filter(Team_Group == Match_Home) %>%
  filter(Defensive_Action == 1)

#set time period
HomePPDAHeatMapDataFT <- HomePPDAHeatMapData

#set PPDA total for time period
HomePPDAFT <- sum(HomePPDAHeatMapDataFT$Home_Defensive_Action)

# Create a new variable to represent the zone for each observation
HomePPDAHeatMapDataFT$zone_x <- cut(HomePPDAHeatMapDataFT$x, breaks = c(0, 17, 33.2, 50, 66.4, 83, 100), include.lowest = TRUE)
HomePPDAHeatMapDataFT$zone_y <- cut(HomePPDAHeatMapDataFT$y, breaks = c(0, 21.1, 36.8, 63.2, 78.9, 100), include.lowest = TRUE)

# Calculate average PPDA for each zone
average_PPDAFT <- HomePPDAHeatMapDataFT %>%
  group_by(zone_x, zone_y) %>%
  summarize(avg_PPDA = sum(Home_Defensive_Action, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(avg_PPDA = round(ifelse(avg_PPDA < 0, abs(avg_PPDA), avg_PPDA), 3),
         PPDA = round(avg_PPDA/HomePPDAFT,3)) 


```

```{r}
#| label: ss-ppda-analysis-setup-2
#| output: false
# Plot the tile plot
PPDAMapplotFT <- ggplot(average_PPDAFT, aes(x = zone_x, y = zone_y, fill = avg_PPDA)) +
  theme_pitch() +
  
  #geometrics
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = PPDA, size = 3)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = ColorScale_HomeC) +
  
  #formatting
  labs(title = paste0(Match_Home," Open Play Defensive Actions Heat Map - Full Game"), 
       subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture,"  \nIncreased Colour = Higher Defensive Actions (DA), \nBox figures = % of Total DA, \nDirection of Attack Right to Left"),
              caption =  My_caption) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
        plot.caption = element_markdown(),
        panel.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
        plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12),
        legend.position = "none", 
        legend.direction = "horizontal", 
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#E5E5E5"), 
        legend.key = element_rect(fill = "#E5E5E5"))

#calculate for combined tile and heat map
average_PPDANZFT <- average_PPDAFT %>%
  mutate(x = ifelse(zone_x == "[0,17]", 8.5,
                    ifelse(zone_x == "(17,33.2]", 25.1,
                           ifelse(zone_x == "(33.2,50]", 41.6,
                                  ifelse(zone_x == "(50,66.4]", 58.2,
                                         ifelse(zone_x == "(66.4,83]", 74.7,
                                                ifelse(zone_x == "(83,100]", 91.5, NA))))))) %>%
  mutate(y = ifelse(zone_y == "[0,21.1]", 10,
                    ifelse(zone_y == "(21.1,36.8]", 30,
                           ifelse(zone_y == "(36.8,63.2]", 50,
                                  ifelse(zone_y == "(63.2,78.9]", 70,
                                         ifelse(zone_y == "(78.9,100]", 90, NA))))))

average_PPDANZFT <- average_PPDANZFT %>%
  group_by(x, y) %>%
  summarise(avg_PPDA = sum(avg_PPDA, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(PPDA = 100*(round(avg_PPDA/HomePPDAFT,2)))
```

```{r}
  filter(Team_Group == Match_Home) %>%
  filter(Defensive_Action == 1) %>%
  mutate(period_displayName = case_when(period_displayName == "FirstHalf" ~ "First Half",
                                        period_displayName == "SecondHalf" ~ "Second Half",
                                        TRUE ~ as.character(period_displayName)))
         
#set for time period
HomePPDAHeatMapDataFT <- HomePPDAHeatMapData


# Calculate average player position
Average_PlayerFT <- HomePPDAHeatMapDataFT %>% 
  group_by(playerId, player_shirt) %>% 
  summarise(x = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), y = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE), events = n()) %>% 
  na.omit()

#set PPDA total for time period
HomePPDAFT <- sum(HomePPDAHeatMapDataFT$Home_Defensive_Action)

#filter by da following pass
Away_Post_DA_Passes <- plottingData %>%
  select(period, period_displayName, Team_Group, playerId, player_shirt, Prog_Passes, Prog_Carries, Attempted_Passes, Successful_Passes, Successful_Long_Passes, Attempted_Carries, Successful_Carries, x, y, finalX, finalY, Prev_Defensive_Action, EPVvalue, EPVStart, EPVEnd)

Away_Post_DA_Passes <- Away_Post_DA_Passes %>%
  filter(Prev_Defensive_Action == 1
         ,Team_Group == Match_Away) %>%
  mutate(Pass_or_Carrie = ifelse(Successful_Passes == 1, 1, 0),
         Prog_Action = ifelse(Prog_Passes == 1 | Prog_Carries == 1, 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(period_displayName = case_when(period_displayName == "FirstHalf" ~ "First Half",
                          period_displayName == "SecondHalf" ~ "Second Half",
                          TRUE ~ as.character(period_displayName)))

  Away_Post_DA_Passes <- shift_column(data = Away_Post_DA_Passes, columns = "playerId", new_names = "receiver", len = 1, up = TRUE)
  Away_Post_DA_Passes <- shift_column(data = Away_Post_DA_Passes, columns = "player_shirt", new_names = "receiver_shirt", len = 1, up = TRUE)
Away_Post_DA_Passes <- shift_column(data = Away_Post_DA_Passes, columns = "Team_Group", new_names = "receiver_team", len = 1, up = TRUE)


AwayPPDAHeatMapData <- plottingData %>%
  filter(Team_Group == Match_Away) %>%
  filter(Defensive_Action == 1) %>%
  mutate(period_displayName = case_when(period_displayName == "FirstHalf" ~ "First Half",
                                        period_displayName == "SecondHalf" ~ "Second Half",
                                        TRUE ~ as.character(period_displayName)))

#set for time period
AwayPPDAHeatMapDataFT <- AwayPPDAHeatMapData

# Calculate average player position
Away_Average_PlayerFT <- AwayPPDAHeatMapDataFT %>% 
  group_by(playerId, player_shirt) %>% 
  summarise(x = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), y = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE), events = n()) %>% 
  na.omit()


#set PPDA total for time period
AwayPPDAFT <- sum(AwayPPDAHeatMapDataFT$Away_Defensive_Action)
```

```{r}
HomePostPPDAHeatMapplotFT <- HomePPDAHeatMapDataFT %>%
  filter(period_displayName == "First Half") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  annotate_pitch(dimensions = pitch_opta, fill = "#E5E5E5", colour = "#454545") +
  theme_pitch() +
  geom_tile() +
  annotate("segment", y = 21.1, yend = 21.1, x = 0, xend = 100, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  annotate("segment", y = 36.8, yend = 36.8, x = 0, xend = 100, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  annotate("segment", y = 63.2, yend = 63.2, x = 0, xend = 100, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  annotate("segment", y = 78.9, yend = 78.9, x = 0, xend = 100, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  annotate("segment", y = 0, yend = 100, x = 17, xend = 17, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  annotate("segment", y = 0, yend = 100, x = 33.2, xend = 33.2, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  annotate("segment", y = 0, yend = 100, x = 50, xend = 50, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  annotate("segment", y = 0, yend = 100, x = 66.4, xend = 66.4, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  annotate("segment", y = 0, yend = 100, x = 83, xend = 83, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#95A5A6", linetype = "longdash") +
  
    #geometrics
  #plot heat map
  stat_density_2d(aes(#color = after_stat(level), 
    fill = after_stat(level)), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  #plot player + shirt for DA win
  #geom_text(data = Average_PlayerFT, aes(x, y, label = player_shirt), color = Color_Home_Text, size = 4) +
  
  #plot next pass or carrie
  geom_link(data = Home_Post_DA_Passes_1st,
               aes( x = x, y = y, xend = finalX, yend = finalY, 
                    color = Prog_Action, 
                    alpha = stat(index),
                    size = after_stat(index)
                    ),
            show.legend = NA,
            inherit.aes = TRUE
  ) +
  
  #plot recieving player from DA
  geom_point(data = Home_Post_DA_Passes_1st, aes(x = finalX, y = finalY, color = Prog_Action), fill = Color_Home, size = 4, shape = 21, stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  
  geom_text(data = Home_Post_DA_Passes_1st, aes(x = finalX, y = finalY, label = receiver_shirt), color = Color_Home_Text, size = 2) +
  
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    colors = c("grey60", Color_Home),
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 1)), 
    breaks = scales::breaks_width(0.01), 
    name = "Progressive Pass") +
  
  #set scales
  scale_size(range = c(0.5, 2)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = ColorScale_HomeC) +
  
  #wrap by half
  #facet_wrap(~period_displayName) +
  
  #formatting
  labs(title = paste(Match_Home,"Passes or Carries Post Successful DA - 1st Half"), 
       subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture,"  \nIncreased Colour = Higher Defensive Actions (DA), \nComets: team colour = Progressive, grey = Successful, \nCircle Number = Recieving player, Direction of Attack Right to Left"),
       caption =  My_caption) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
        plot.caption = element_markdown(),
        panel.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
        plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12),
        legend.position = "none", 
        legend.background = element_blank(), 
        legend.key = element_blank(), 
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = Color_Home_Text, face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = Color_Home, color = "black", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.5))
```

## PPDA (Standard Definition)
```{r}
#| title: PPDA Table
#| label: season proper ppda table

ai_gt(ppda_proper, "PPDA - Opposition Passes in Their Own 60% per Defensive Action",
      subtitle = paste0(Season_Label, " | for comparison, simple PPDA (all passes / all defensive actions): ",
                        Match_Home, " ", HomePPDA_Simple, ", ", Match_Away, " ", AwayPPDA_Simple),
      rowname = "Period") %>%
  gt_team_spanners() %>%
  fmt_number(columns = ends_with("PPDA"), decimals = 2) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = ends_with(c("passes", "actions")), decimals = 0, sep_mark = ",") %>%
  tab_footnote("Season totals: all opposition passes in their own 60% divided by all defensive actions in that zone, so busier games count for more. Lower PPDA = more intense pressing.")
```

```{r}
#| title: PPDA by Quarter
#| label: season proper ppda chart
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| fig-dpi: 150

ppda_q <- ppda_proper %>%
  filter(grepl("Quarter", Period)) %>%
  select(Period, ends_with("| PPDA")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Period, names_to = "TeamName", values_to = "PPDA") %>%
  mutate(TeamName = factor(sub(" \\| PPDA$", "", TeamName), levels = c(Match_Home, Match_Away)))

ggplot(ppda_q, aes(x = Period, y = PPDA, fill = TeamName)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, colour = "#454545", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(PPDA), "", format(PPDA, nsmall = 2))), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 2.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = team_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = "PPDA by Quarter (lower = more pressing)",
       subtitle = paste0(Season_Label, " | opposition passes in their own 60% per defensive action"),
```

```{r}
plot_regain_to_shot <- function(team) {
  d <- regain_shots %>% filter(TeamName == .env$team) %>% mutate(t = pmin(Duration, 60))
  ggplot(d, aes(x = t, y = xg)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = fast_window, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = fast_window / 2, y = Inf, label = paste0("Within ", fast_window, "s"),
             vjust = 1.5, size = 2.3, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_point(fill = team_col(team), shape = 21, colour = "black", size = 2.2, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_image(data = d %>% filter(Goal), aes(x = t, y = xg, image = ball_icon), size = 0.035) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 62), breaks = seq(0, 60, 10), labels = c(seq(0, 50, 10), "60+")) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(c(d$xg, 0.3)) * 1.15)) +
    labs(title = paste0(team, " - Seconds from Regain to Shot"),
         subtitle = paste0(Season_Label, " | each dot is a shot from an open-play regain, balls = goals"),
         x = "Seconds after winning the ball", y = "xG", caption = My_caption) +
    line_theme(legend_position = "none")
}
plot_regain_to_shot(Match_Home)
```

```{r}
#| title: Transitions Summary

transition_table <- function(team) {
  transition_team(team) %>%
    mutate(Group = ifelse(grepl("conceded", Metric), "After losing the ball", "After winning the ball")) %>%
    ai_gt(paste0(team, " - Transitions"), group = "Group", rowname = "Metric") %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(Total, `Per game`), decimals = 2, drop_trailing_zeros = TRUE) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = team_txt(team)), cell_fill(color = team_col(team))),
              locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", color = team_txt(team)), cell_fill(color = team_col(team))),
              locations = cells_row_groups()) %>%
    tab_footnote("Open-play regain = a sequence started by winning the ball in play (tackle, interception, recovery or an opponent's misplaced pass).")
}
transition_table(Match_Home)
```

```{r}
#| label: season pressing setup
#| output: false

# Season pressing database built by Build_Pressing_Season_DB.R (one sheet,
# every match's pressing events stacked). Rows are matched to the season's
# games by date, and the pressing team is grouped as focus team / All Oppo.
press_db <- paste0("~/Documents/Dropbox files/AI LFC data/Data Sets/AI Pressing/Season 2627/Database/AI_Pressing_Season_2627.csv")
has_press <- file.exists(press_db)

no_press_plot <- function() {
  ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, size = 4,
                      label = "No season pressing database yet - run Build_Pressing_Season_DB.R") +
    theme_void() + theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"))
}

if (has_press) {
  press <- readr::read_csv(press_db, guess_max = 100000, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE) %>%
    filter(Home_Team == Match_Home | Away_Team == Match_Home) %>%
    mutate(.date = as.Date(Game_date, format = "%d-%m-%Y"),
           TeamName = ifelse(`Pressing Team` == Match_Home, Match_Home, Match_Away),
           TeamName = factor(TeamName, levels = c(Match_Home, Match_Away)),
           x = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)), y = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))) %>%
    left_join(games %>% select(Date, Game_No, Game_Label, Opp_Abbr, game_name), by = c(".date" = "Date"))
  press_games <- n_distinct(press$Fixture)
  press_flag <- function(col) coalesce(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(press[[col]])), 0)
  for (cl in c("Presses", "Successful_Presses", "Won_Possession", "Pushed_Opponent_Back", "Counter_Press",
               "Group_Press", "Turnover", "Led to Shot", "Led to Goal", "Failed_Press", "Conceeded_Shot",
               "Conceeded_Cross", "Conceeded_Free_Kick", "High Value Presses", "EPV Threat Prevented")) {
    press[[cl]] <- press_flag(cl)
  }

  # opponent passes in the games that have pressing data (for passes per press)
  opp_passes <- ev %>%
    filter(game_name %in% press$game_name, is_pass) %>%
    count(TeamName, name = "passes") %>%
    mutate(TeamName = opp_of(TeamName))   # passes BY the opponent of the pressing side

  press_team_summary <- press %>%
    group_by(TeamName) %>%
    summarise(Presses = sum(Presses), `Successful presses` = sum(Successful_Presses),
              `Won possession` = sum(Won_Possession), `Pushed back` = sum(Pushed_Opponent_Back),
              `Counter presses` = sum(Counter_Press), `Group presses` = sum(Group_Press),
              Turnovers = sum(Turnover), `Led to shot` = sum(`Led to Shot`), `Led to goal` = sum(`Led to Goal`),
              `Failed presses` = sum(Failed_Press),
              `Conceded shot / cross / FK` = sum(Conceeded_Shot + Conceeded_Cross + Conceeded_Free_Kick),
              `Presses in attacking third` = sum(coalesce(x >= 66.7, FALSE)),
              `EPV threat prevented` = round(sum(`EPV Threat Prevented`), 2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(opp_passes %>% mutate(TeamName = factor(TeamName, levels = c(Match_Home, Match_Away))), by = "TeamName") %>%
    mutate(`Press success %` = round(100 * `Successful presses` / Presses),
           `Opp. passes per press` = round(passes / Presses, 2)) %>%
    select(-passes)

  press_by_game <- press %>%
    group_by(TeamName, Game_No, Game_Label, Opp_Abbr) %>%
    summarise(Presses = sum(Presses), Success = sum(Successful_Presses), Won = sum(Won_Possession), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(`Success %` = round(100 * Success / Presses)) %>%
    arrange(TeamName, Game_No) %>%
    group_by(TeamName) %>%
    mutate(Presses_roll3 = zoo::rollapplyr(Presses, 3, mean, partial = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # player minutes = the most minutes recorded for him in each game, summed
  press_players <- press %>%
    filter(TeamName == Match_Home, !is.na(playerId), playerId != "Team pressure") %>%
    group_by(playerId, Fixture) %>%
    summarise(mins = max(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(minutes_played)), na.rm = TRUE),
              Presses = sum(Presses), Success = sum(Successful_Presses), Won = sum(Won_Possession),
              Counter = sum(Counter_Press), HV = sum(`High Value Presses`), Shot = sum(`Led to Shot`),
              Position = dplyr::first(Position), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Player = playerId) %>%
    summarise(Position = names(sort(table(Position), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
              Games = n(), Minutes = round(sum(pmax(mins, 0))), Presses = sum(Presses),
              `Presses p90` = ifelse(Minutes > 0, round(90 * Presses / Minutes, 1), NA),
              `Success %` = round(100 * sum(Success) / Presses), `Won possession` = sum(Won),
              `Counter presses` = sum(Counter), `High value` = sum(HV), `Led to shot` = sum(Shot),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(Presses))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: ss-xg-analysis-3
#| include: false
#| eval: false
ShotBubblexG_data <- plottingData 

ShotBubblexG_data <- ShotBubblexG_data %>%
  filter(Team_Group == Match_Home)

ShotBubblexG_data <- ShotBubblexG_data %>%
group_by(expandedMinute, Game_Period) %>%
  summarize(
    Attempted_Passes = sum(Attempted_Passes),
    Touches = sum(Touches),
    OFShots = sum(OFShots),
    OTShots = sum(OTShots),
    Goals = sum(Goals),
    xG = sum(xG),
    EPV = sum(EPV),
    TotalShots = sum(TotalShots),) %>%
  filter(OFShots > 0 | OTShots > 0 | Goals > 0 )

xGBubblePlot_data <- ShotBubblexG_data %>% 
  select(Game_Period, expandedMinute, Attempted_Passes, Touches, OFShots, OTShots, Goals, xG, EPV)

xGBubblePlot_data <- xGBubblePlot_data %>%
  group_by(Game_Period) %>%
  mutate(xG = round(xG,2)) %>%
  mutate(EPV = round(EPV,2)) %>%
  summarize(
    Attempted_Passes = sum(Attempted_Passes),
    Touches = sum(Touches),
    OFShots = sum(OFShots),
    OTShots = sum(OTShots),
    Goals = sum(Goals),
    xG = sum(xG),
    EPV = sum(EPV),
    TotalShots = sum(OFShots + OTShots + Goals),
  )  

#set plot size range
sizeRange <- c(2, 10)

# change data to enable shape to be defined 
  xGBubblePlot_data_pivot <- xGBubblePlot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("EPV", "xG"), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
      mutate(Shape = ifelse(Metric == "xG", "Circle", "Diamond"))
  
  #load final data frame for plot
  xGBubble_Plot <- xGBubblePlot_data_pivot %>%
  
  #Canvas      
  ggplot(aes(x = Attempted_Passes, y = TotalShots, size = Value, fill = Value, text = paste(Metric, ": ", Value, "\nTime Period: ", Game_Period))) +
  
  #geometrics  
  geom_point(aes(shape = Metric), colour = "black", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c( "xG" = 21, "EPV" = 23)) +  # Assign different shapes

  #colors
  #scale_fill_paletteer_d(ColorScale_Home, 1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = ColorScale_HomeC) +
  
  #Scale and limits
  scale_size(range = sizeRange) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 600), breaks = seq(0, 600, 50)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 50), breaks = seq(0, 50, 5)) +

  #formatting
  labs(title = paste0(Match_Home, " xG (Circles) & EPV (Diamonds) Creation by Time Period"),
         subtitle = paste0(Match_Fixture),
         caption = My_caption,
         x = "Passes",
         y = "Shots") +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
        plot.caption = element_markdown(),
        panel.background = element_rect(colour = "snow", fill = "snow"),
        plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        axis.title = element_text(colour = "gray12", size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#454545", size = 0.4, linetype = "dashed"),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(colour = "#454545", size = 0.4, linetype = "dashed"),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none", 
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank())

xGBubble_Plot_I  <- ggplotly(xGBubble_Plot, tooltip = "text")

xGBubble_Plot_I <- xGBubble_Plot_I %>%
config(displayModeBar = TRUE, 
       displaylogo = FALSE,
       toImageButtonOptions = list(position = "bottom"),
       modeBarButtonsToRemove = list('lasso2d','select2d',  'zoomIn2d', 'zoomOut2d', 'autoScale2d', 'pan2d', 'hoverClosestCartesian', 'hoverCompareCartesian'))

xGBubble_Plot_I
```

```{r}
  geom_col(aes(y = Prevented, fill = Prevented >= 0), width = 0.7, colour = "#454545", linewidth = 0.2) +

  geom_point(aes(y = Cum_Prevented), colour = "black", size = 1.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = col_success, `FALSE` = col_fail), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = games$Game_No, labels = games$Opp_Abbr) +
  labs(title = paste0(Match_Home, " Goals Prevented by Game (", paste(gk_keepers, collapse = " / "), ")"),
       subtitle = paste0(Season_Label, " | bar = xGOT faced minus goals conceded that game (team colour = kept out more than expected, grey = fewer), line = season running total"),
       x = NULL, y = "Goals prevented", caption = My_caption) +
  line_theme(legend_position = "none") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6))
```

## Goalkeeper Maps {.flow}
### Distribution
```{r}
#| title: Distribution
#| label: season gk distribution
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| fig-dpi: 150

gk_dist <- gk_ev %>% filter(TeamName == Match_Home, is_pass, !is.na(end_x))
ggplot(gk_dist) +
  pitch_base() +
  geom_point(aes(x = end_x, y = end_y, colour = ifelse(out == 1, "Successful", "Unsuccessful"),
                 shape = Distance), size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Successful = col_success, Unsuccessful = col_fail)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Long = 16, Short = 1)) +
  pitch_title(paste0(Match_Home, " Goalkeeper Distribution - Where Passes Ended"),
              paste0(Season_Label, " | ", paste(gk_keepers, collapse = " / "), " | long ",
                     sum(gk_dist$Distance == "Long"), " (", pct_txt(sum(gk_dist$Distance == "Long" & gk_dist$out == 1), sum(gk_dist$Distance == "Long")),
                     " success), short ", sum(gk_dist$Distance == "Short"), " (",
                     pct_txt(sum(gk_dist$Distance == "Short" & gk_dist$out == 1), sum(gk_dist$Distance == "Short")), ")"))
```

### Actions
```{r}
#| title: Actions
#| label: season gk actions
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| fig-dpi: 150

gk_act <- gk_ev %>% filter(TeamName == Match_Home, !is.na(Action), !is.na(x))
ggplot(gk_act) +
  pitch_base() +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 17, ymin = 21.1, ymax = 78.9, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y, shape = Action, colour = ifelse(Sweeper, "Outside box / sweeper", "Inside box")),
             size = 1.6, stroke = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Save = 16, Claim = 17, Punch = 15, `Pick-up` = 1, Smother = 18, Sweeper = 8, `Other defensive` = 4)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Outside box / sweeper` = Color_Home, `Inside box` = "grey30")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 50)) +
  pitch_title(paste0(Match_Home, " Goalkeeper Actions"),
              paste0(Season_Label, " | saves, claims, punches, pick-ups and sweeper actions"))
```

# Methods

  HOW TO EDIT THIS PAGE
  Each metric sits in its own card. Replace the text marked

## Row

::: {.card .method-card title="Data & conventions"}
**Event data:** Opta (via WhoScored), processed with the Under Pressure pipeline.

**Pitch:** Opta coordinates, 0-100 on both axes; zone lines mark the thirds, the channels and Zone 14 / half-spaces.

**Season view:** every game in the season database that the focus team played (all competitions in this file). The focus team is compared with **All Oppo** - every opponent grouped together. Per-game figures are season totals divided by the number of games; season PPDA and percentages are built from the season totals (so busier games count for more).

**Goals:** include own goals, credited to the team that benefited (the pipeline's Home_Goals / Away_Goals, turned round when the focus team played away).

**Game state:** from the focus team's point of view - Winning, Draw, Losing, and Garbage Time (winning / losing) for big leads. The pipeline's Home / Away Lead labels are converted per game.

**Game blocks:** worked out from the dates - a new block starts after any gap of 11+ days between games (international breaks).

**Game-state buttons:** on the Season Summary (simulations), Passing, Player, EPV, PPDA, xG and Shot pages every chart and table has buttons for All, Winning, Drawing, Losing and Garbage Time. Each state is built from the same code with the events filtered to that state; a state with too little data shows a note instead of a chart.

**Recent form:** the last 5 games' per-game averages against the season average (team colour = better, grey = worse; for goals, xG, shots and EPV against and PPDA, lower is better). **Home vs away:** per-game averages split by venue.

**Up to 1st sub (season):** each game up to that game's first substitution, skipping subs before minute 15 (`min_sub_window`); subtitles show the median first-sub minute.

## Row

::: {.card .method-card title="Possession, Field Tilt and Possession Control"}
**Possession %:** share of the two teams' combined touches.

**Field Tilt %:** share of the two teams' combined final-third touches.

**Possession Control:** possession won (interceptions, recoveries, net tackles, net aerials) minus possession lost (miscontrols, dispossessions, failed passes, crosses and dribbles, off-target and blocked shots, offsides).

**Poss Control /100 Touches:** Possession Control divided by touches x 100, so players and teams with different amounts of the ball can be compared. In the player tables it is greyed out for players with fewer than 20 touches (set by `min_touches_pc`).

[ADD DEFINITION - any interpretation notes]
:::

::: {.card .method-card title="PPDA and PPDO"}
**PPDA (passes per defensive action):** opponent passes in their own 60% of the pitch divided by the team's tackles, interceptions, challenges and fouls committed in that same zone. Lower = more intense pressing. This one definition is used for the overview value box, the PPDA development plots, the PPDA table, the substitution windows and the match report (`ppda_definition <- "standard"`; set it to `"simple"` for the older all-passes / all-defensive-actions version, which is also shown in the PPDA table subtitle).

**PPDO:** [ADD DEFINITION]
:::

## Row

::: {.card .method-card title="Pressing: PAPA and OPPP"}
**PAPA (possession-adjusted pressing actions):** presses scaled by the cube root of opponent possession over own possession, calculated per minute and shown as a rolling percentile.

**OPPP (opponent passes per press):** [ADD DEFINITION]

## Row

::: {.card .method-card title="Match outcome simulations (Monte Carlo)"}
Each shot is simulated as a goal / no goal event 10,000 times, and the goals are summed per simulation to give scoreline and result probabilities.

- **xG only:** each shot scores with probability = its xG.
- **Blended:** probability = 0.4 x xG + 0.6 x xGOT.
- **Optimistic:** the higher of xG and xGOT for each shot.
- **Pessimistic:** the lower of xG and xGOT for each shot.

Shots with no xGOT value fall back to xG in all three. [ADD DEFINITION - note whether off-target shots carry xGOT = 0 in your data, which makes them count as 0 in the blended and pessimistic versions]

Own goals are not shots, so they are not simulated - the actual score can sit outside the simulated range.

[ADD DEFINITION - how to read the charts]
:::

::: {.card .method-card title="Time splits, touch areas and pass connections"}
**Game periods:** 15-minute blocks (0-15 ... 76-90, 90+).

**Game quarters:** 1st (1-25), 2nd (26 to the end of the first half), 3rd (start of the second half to 70), 4th (71-99), with everything else (extra time) as Injury Time.

**Touch / press areas:** the area covering activity within 1.5 MAD of the player's median position (about 75% of actions); dot = average position.

**Pass connections:** built from completed passes only (Opta records no intended receiver for an incomplete pass). Line colour on pass networks = the two players' overall completion %, weighted by passes on that link.

[ADD DEFINITION - game state labels, e.g. garbage time]
:::

## Row

::: {.card .method-card title="Possession sequences, set pieces and entries"}
**Sequence:** starts when a team gets the ball (pass, carry, shot, take-on, touch, interception, recovery, won tackle, keeper claim/pick-up) and runs until the other team has it, the period ends or play restarts from a dead ball. Its **start type** is the first event: corner, free kick, throw-in, goal kick, kick-off, keeper, or open-play regain.

**Shot-creating sequence:** the sequence a shot belongs to. Passes = completed and attempted passes in it before the shot; duration = seconds from its first event to the shot.

**Set pieces:** corners, free kicks and throw-ins from the Opta corner/free-kick flags and qualifiers 5, 6 and 107. A **short corner** is the Short_Corners flag or a corner pass under 20m. **First contact** = the team of the next event within 8 seconds (aerial duels go to the winner); none if the ball goes out first. **Set-piece xG** uses the shot's situation where available, otherwise the start type of its sequence.

**Box / final-third entries:** open-play passes and carries starting outside the box (or below the final third) and ending inside it. Channel = where the action started: wings (outer 21.1%), half-spaces, central. A **carry** is the ball moved 5m+ between where a player received it (end of the previous same-team event) and his next on-ball action, within 10 seconds. Taken from the processing pipeline (Carry_Start_X/Y to C_End_point_X/Y); files processed before that fix use the dashboard's own equivalent definition.

[ADD DEFINITION - anything you want to add]
:::

::: {.card .method-card title="Transitions, defensive shape and PPDA"}
**Open-play regain:** a sequence started by winning the ball in play rather than from a restart or the keeper. **Regain to shot** = seconds from the regain to the shot; the fast-transition window is 15 seconds. Conceded = the opponent's shots after your team lost the ball.

**DA height:** average position of defensive actions in metres from the team's own goal (105m pitch). **Block depth / width:** by default (`block_method <- "mad"`) the span of the median +/- 1.5 MAD (`mad_k`) of defensive-action positions along and across the pitch, drawn as a box (`block_shape <- "hull"` draws the outline of the actions inside instead); the block line is the median. Set `block_method <- "quantile"` for the 10th-90th percentile box with the mean as the line. **On-ball height:** average position of the team's on-ball events.

**PPDA (standard):** opponent passes in their own 60% of the pitch divided by your tackles, interceptions, challenges and fouls in that same zone (your attacking 60%). Lower = more intense pressing. The older dashboard PPDA (all passes / all defensive actions) is shown in the table subtitle for comparison.

[ADD DEFINITION]
:::

## Row


::: {.card .method-card title="Goalkeepers"}
**Goals prevented:** xGOT of shots on target faced minus goals conceded (own goals excluded). Positive = the keeper kept out more than an average keeper would.

**Distribution:** keeper passes; long = Opta long ball or 32m+. **Sweeper actions:** Opta keeper-sweeper events plus claims, punches and defensive actions outside the penalty area.

:::
